JEB13\\n    {'dir': EB, 'anm': 'JEB13', 'date': '2022-09-13', 'probes': [2]},\\n    {'dir': EB, 'anm': 'JEB13', 'date': '2022-09-14', 'probes': [2]},\\n    {'dir': EB, 'anm': 'JEB13', 'date': '2022-09-21', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': EB, 'anm': 'JEB13', 'date': '2022-09-24', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': EB, 'anm': 'JEB13', 'date': '2022-09-25', 'probes': [1]},\\n    # JEB14\\n    {'dir': EB, 'anm': 'JEB14', 'date': '2022-08-22', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': EB, 'anm': 'JEB14', 'date': '2022-08-23', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': EB, 'anm': 'JEB14', 'date': '2022-08-24', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': EB, 'anm': 'JEB14', 'date': '2022-08-25', 'probes': [1]},\\n    # JEB15 - all 4 sessions per loading script (first 3 have note about\\n    # sensory area but are still included in the loading script)\\n    {'dir': EB, 'anm': 'JEB15', 'date': '2022-07-26', 'probes': [1, 2]},\\n    {'dir': EB, 'anm': 'JEB15', 'date': '2022-07-27', 'probes': [1, 2]},\\n    {'dir': EB, 'anm': 'JEB15', 'date': '2022-07-28', 'probes': [1, 2]},\\n    {'dir': EB, 'anm': 'JEB15', 'date': '2022-07-29', 'probes': [2]},\\n    # JEB19\\n    {'dir': EB, 'anm': 'JEB19', 'date': '2023-04-21', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': EB, 'anm': 'JEB19', 'date': '2023-04-20', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': EB, 'anm': 'JEB19', 'date': '2023-04-19', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': EB, 'anm': 'JEB19', 'date': '2023-04-18', 'probes': [1]},\\n    # --- RandomizedDelay_Ephys_Behavior ---\\n    # JEB11\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB11', 'date': '2022-05-10', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB11', 'date': '2022-05-11', 'probes': [1]},\\n    # JEB12\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB12', 'date': '2022-05-12', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB12', 'date': '2022-05-13', 'probes': [1]},\\n    # JEB23\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB23', 'date': '2023-10-10', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB23', 'date': '2023-10-11', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB23', 'date': '2023-10-12', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB23', 'date': '2023-10-13', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB23', 'date': '2023-10-18', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB23', 'date': '2023-10-19', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB23', 'date': '2023-10-21', 'probes': [1]},\\n    # JEB24\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB24', 'date': '2023-10-23', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB24', 'date': '2023-10-24', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB24', 'date': '2023-10-25', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB24', 'date': '2023-10-26', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB24', 'date': '2023-10-27', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB24', 'date': '2023-10-31', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB24', 'date': '2023-11-02', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB24', 'date': '2023-11-03', 'probes': [1]},\\n]\\n\\n\\n# ============================================================\\n# HELPER FUNCTIONS\\n# ============================================================\\n\\ndef gausswin(N, alpha=2.5):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"MATLAB-equivalent gausswin(N, alpha).\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    if N == 1:\\n        return np.array([1.0])\\n    n = np.arange(N)\\n    n_norm = 2 * n / (N - 1) - 1\\n    return np.exp(-0.5 * (alpha * n_norm) ** 2)\\n\\n\\ndef causal_smooth(x, N=SMOOTH_N, bctype=BC_TYPE):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Causal Gaussian smoothing matching mySmooth.m.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    if N <= 1:\\n        return x.copy()\\n    kern = gausswin(N)\\n    kern[:N // 2] = 0   # causal: zero out first half\\n    kern /= kern.sum()\\n\\n    if bctype == 'reflect':\\n        x_padded = np.concatenate([x[:N], x])\\n        trim = N\\n    elif bctype == 'zeropad':\\n        x_padded = np.concatenate([np.zeros(N), x])\\n        trim = N\\n    else:\\n        x_padded = x.copy()\\n        trim = 0\\n\\n    out = np.convolve(x_padded, kern, mode='same')\\n    return out[trim:]\\n\\n\\ndef h5str(f, ref):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Read string from HDF5 object reference.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    data = f[ref][()].flatten()\\n    return ''.join(chr(int(c)) for c in data)\\n\\n\\ndef fill_nan_nearest(arr):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Fill NaN values with nearest non-NaN, matching MATLAB fillmissing('nearest').\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    nans = np.isnan(arr)\\n    if not np.any(nans):\\n        return arr\\n    if np.all(nans):\\n        arr[:] = 0\\n        return arr\\n    valid_idx = np.where(~nans)[0]\\n    f_interp = interp1d(valid_idx, arr[valid_idx], kind='nearest',\\n                        fill_value='extrapolate', bounds_error=False)\\n    arr[nans] = f_interp(np.where(nans)[0])\\n    return arr\\n\\n\\ndef compute_mode(arr):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Compute statistical mode.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    arr = arr[~np.isnan(arr)]\\n    if len(arr) == 0:\\n        return 0.0\\n    vals, counts = np.unique(arr, return_counts=True)\\n    return float(vals[np.argmax(counts)])\\n\\n\\ndef fill_positions_nearest(x, y, valid_mask):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Fill invalid positions with nearest valid values.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    x, y = x.copy(), y.copy()\\n    if not np.any(valid_mask) or np.all(valid_mask):\\n        return x, y\\n    valid_idx = np.where(valid_mask)[0]\\n    bad_idx = np.where(~valid_mask)[0]\\n    nearest = np.searchsorted(valid_idx, bad_idx).clip(0, len(valid_idx) - 1)\\n    # Check left neighbor too for true nearest\\n    left = np.clip(nearest - 1, 0, len(valid_idx) - 1)\\n    d_right = np.abs(bad_idx - valid_idx[nearest])\\n    d_left = np.abs(bad_idx - valid_idx[left])\\n    use_left = d_left < d_right\\n    final = np.where(use_left, left, nearest)\\n    x[bad_idx] = x[valid_idx[final]]\\n    y[bad_idx] = y[valid_idx[final]]\\n    return x, y\\n\\n\\ndef compute_speed(x, y, ft, confidence=None, conf_thresh=DLC_CONF,\\n                  fill_missing=True):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Compute instantaneous speed from (x, y) trajectory.\\n\\n    For all features, fills NaN/low-confidence positions with nearest valid\\n    position before computing velocity, matching the paper's processing for\\n    kinematic features. For tongue, positions are NaN when not visible; filling\\n    gives near-zero velocity during non-licking periods and meaningful velocity\\n    during licking.\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    x = x.copy().astype(np.float64)\\n    y = y.copy().astype(np.float64)\\n\\n    # Determine valid frames: not NaN and (optionally) high confidence\\n    valid = ~np.isnan(x) & ~np.isnan(y)\\n    if confidence is not None:\\n        valid = valid & (confidence >= conf_thresh)\\n\\n    if np.any(valid) and not np.all(valid):\\n        x, y = fill_positions_nearest(x, y, valid)\\n    elif not np.any(valid):\\n        return np.zeros(len(x))\\n\\n    # Remove remaining NaN (shouldn't happen after fill, but safety)\\n    x = np.nan_to_num(x, nan=0.0)\\n    y = np.nan_to_num(y, nan=0.0)\\n\\n    dt_vid = np.diff(ft)\\n    dt_vid[dt_vid <= 0] = 1.0 / 400.0\\n\\n    vx = np.diff(x) / dt_vid\\n    vy = np.diff(y) / dt_vid\\n    speed = np.sqrt(vx**2 + vy**2)\\n    speed = np.concatenate([[0.0], speed])\\n\\n    return speed\\n\\n\\n# ============================================================\\n# SESSION PROCESSING\\n# ============================================================\\n\\ndef _is_hdf5(path):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Check if a .mat file is HDF5 (MATLAB v7.3) format.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    try:\\n        with open(path, 'rb') as fp:\\n            header = fp.read(4)\\n        return header == b'\\\\x89HDF'\\n    except Exception:\\n        return False\\n\\n\\ndef _load_session_v5(data_path, sess):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Load session data from MATLAB v5 format into common dict.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    d = scipy.io.loadmat(data_path)\\n    obj = d['obj']\\n    bp = obj['bp'][0, 0]\\n\\n    n_trials = int(bp['Ntrials'][0, 0])\\n    hit = bp['hit'][0, 0].flatten()[:n_trials].astype(int)\\n    miss = bp['miss'][0, 0].flatten()[:n_trials].astype(int)\\n    early = bp['early'][0, 0].flatten()[:n_trials].astype(int)\\n    no_resp = bp['no'][0, 0].flatten()[:n_trials].astype(int)\\n    L = bp['L'][0, 0].flatten()[:n_trials].astype(int)\\n    R = bp['R'][0, 0].flatten()[:n_trials].astype(int)\\n    autowater = bp['autowater'][0, 0].flatten()[:n_trials].astype(int)\\n\\n    stim = bp['stim'][0, 0]\\n    stim_en_raw = stim['enable'][0, 0]\\n    if stim_en_raw.ndim >= 2:\\n        stim_en = stim_en_raw.flatten()[:n_trials].astype(int)\\n    else:\\n        stim_en = stim_en_raw.flatten()[:n_trials].astype(int)\\n\\n    ev = bp['ev'][0, 0]\\n    goCue = ev['goCue'][0, 0].flatten()[:n_trials].astype(float)\\n\\n    # video offset\\n    try:\\n        bitStart_vals = ev['bitStart'][0, 0].flatten()[:n_trials].astype(float)\\n        bitStart_mode = compute_mode(bitStart_vals)\\n        sglx = obj['sglx'][0, 0]\\n        bc = sglx['bitcode'][0, 0]\\n        bc_bs = bc['bitstart'][0, 0].flatten().astype(float)\\n        bc_bs_mode = compute_mode(bc_bs)\\n        fs = float(sglx['fs'][0, 0])\\n        vidshift = bc_bs_mode / fs - bitStart_mode\\n    except Exception as e:\\n        vidshift = 0.5\\n\\n    # cluster data\\n    clu_cell = obj['clu'][0, 0]  # (1, nProbes) object array\\n    spike_data = []\\n    for prb in sess['probes']:\\n        pidx = prb - 1\\n        try:\\n            probe_arr = clu_cell[0, pidx]  # struct array (1, nClusters)\\n        except Exception:\\n            print(f\\\"  Probe {prb}: empty\\\")\\n            continue\\n        n_clu = probe_arr.shape[1]\\n        qualities = []\\n        for i in range(n_clu):\\n            q = str(probe_arr['quality'][0, i].item()).strip()\\n            qualities.append(q)\\n\\n        valid_clu = [i for i, q in enumerate(qualities)\\n                     if q.lower() not in EXCLUDED_QUALITIES and q != '']\\n        q_counts = {}\\n        for q in qualities:\\n            q_counts[q] = q_counts.get(q, 0) + 1\\n        print(f\\\"  Probe {prb}: {n_clu} total, {len(valid_clu)} valid  {q_counts}\\\")\\n\\n        for ci in valid_clu:\\n            spike_data.append({\\n                'trial': probe_arr['trial'][0, ci].flatten().astype(float),\\n                'trialtm': probe_arr['trialtm'][0, ci].flatten().astype(float),\\n            })\\n\\n    # DLC bottom cam\\n    traj_cell = obj['traj'][0, 0]  # (1, 2) for [side, bottom]\\n    bot_cam = None\\n    try:\\n        bot_arr = traj_cell[0, 1]  # struct array (1, nTrials)\\n        # feature names from first trial\\n        fn_raw = bot_arr[0, 0]['featNames']\\n        feat_names = []\\n        for i in range(fn_raw.shape[0]):\\n            try:\\n                feat_names.append(str(fn_raw[i, 0].item()))\\n            except Exception:\\n                feat_names.append(str(fn_raw[i].item()))\\n        if not feat_names:\\n            for i in range(fn_raw.shape[1]):\\n                feat_names.append(str(fn_raw[0, i].item()))\\n\\n        bot_cam = {'feat_names': feat_names, 'n_cam_trials': bot_arr.shape[1]}\\n\\n        def get_bot_trial(ti):\\n            t = bot_arr[0, ti]\\n            ts = t['ts'].astype(float)  # (nframes, 3, nfeat)\\n            ft = t['frameTimes'].flatten().astype(float)\\n            return ts, ft\\n\\n        bot_cam['get_trial'] = get_bot_trial\\n    except Exception as e:\\n        print(f\\\"  WARNING: DLC bottom cam: {e}\\\")\\n\\n    # side cam frameTimes\\n    side_ft = {}\\n    try:\\n        side_arr = traj_cell[0, 0]\\n        for ti in range(min(n_trials, side_arr.shape[1])):\\n            try:\\n                side_ft[ti] = side_arr[0, ti]['frameTimes'].flatten().astype(float)\\n            except Exception:\\n                pass\\n    except Exception as e:\\n        print(f\\\"  WARNING: side cam frameTimes: {e}\\\")\\n\\n    return {\\n        'n_trials': n_trials, 'hit': hit, 'miss': miss, 'early': early,\\n        'no_resp': no_resp, 'L': L, 'R': R, 'autowater': autowater,\\n        'stim_en': stim_en, 'goCue': goCue, 'vidshift': vidshift,\\n        'spike_data': spike_data, 'bot_cam': bot_cam, 'side_ft': side_ft,\\n    }\\n\\n\\ndef _load_session_h5(data_path, sess):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Load session data from HDF5 (v7.3) format into common dict.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    spike_data = []\\n    bot_cam = None\\n    side_ft = {}\\n\\n    with h5py.File(data_path, 'r') as f:\\n        obj = f['obj']\\n        bp = obj['bp']\\n\\n        n_trials = int(bp['Ntrials'][0, 0])\\n        hit   = bp['hit'][0, :n_trials].astype(int)\\n        miss  = bp['miss'][0, :n_trials].astype(int)\\n        early = bp['early'][0, :n_trials].astype(int)\\n        no_resp = bp['no'][0, :n_trials].astype(int)\\n        L     = bp['L'][0, :n_trials].astype(int)\\n        R     = bp['R'][0, :n_trials].astype(int)\\n        autowater = bp['autowater'][0, :n_trials].astype(int)\\n        stim_en   = bp['stim']['enable'][0, :n_trials].astype(int)\\n        goCue     = bp['ev']['goCue'][0, :n_trials].copy()\\n\\n        # video offset\\n        try:\\n            bitStart_mode = compute_mode(bp['ev']['bitStart'][0, :n_trials])\\n            bc_bs = obj['sglx']['bitcode']['bitstart'][0, :]\\n            bc_bs_mode = compute_mode(bc_bs)\\n            fs = float(obj['sglx']['fs'][0, 0])\\n            vidshift = bc_bs_mode / fs - bitStart_mode\\n        except Exception as e:\\n            vidshift = 0.5\\n\\n        # cluster data\\n        clu_group = obj['clu']\\n        for prb in sess['probes']:\\n            pidx = prb - 1\\n            try:\\n                prb_ref = clu_group[pidx, 0]\\n                prb_g = f[prb_ref]\\n            except Exception:\\n                print(f\\\"  Probe {prb}: empty\\\")\\n                continue\\n\\n            quality_ds = prb_g['quality']\\n            n_clu = quality_ds.shape[0]\\n            qualities = []\\n            for i in range(n_clu):\\n                try:\\n                    q = h5str(f, quality_ds[i, 0]).strip()\\n                except Exception:\\n                    q = ''\\n                qualities.append(q)\\n\\n            valid_clu = [i for i, q in enumerate(qualities)\\n                         if q.lower() not in EXCLUDED_QUALITIES and q != '']\\n            q_counts = {}\\n            for q in qualities:\\n                q_counts[q] = q_counts.get(q, 0) + 1\\n            print(f\\\"  Probe {prb}: {n_clu} total, {len(valid_clu)} valid  {q_counts}\\\")\\n\\n            for ci in valid_clu:\\n                spike_data.append({\\n                    'trial':   f[prb_g['trial'][ci, 0]][()].flatten(),\\n                    'trialtm': f[prb_g['trialtm'][ci, 0]][()].flatten(),\\n                })\\n\\n        # DLC bottom cam - read all trial data into memory\\n        traj = obj['traj']\\n        bot_trials_data = {}\\n        try:\\n            vbot_ref = traj[1, 0]\\n            vbot = f[vbot_ref]\\n            fn_ref = vbot['featNames'][0, 0]\\n            fn_arr = f[fn_ref][:]\\n            feat_names = [h5str(f, fn_arr[0, i]) for i in range(fn_arr.shape[1])]\\n\\n            for ti in range(n_trials):\\n                try:\\n                    ts = f[vbot['ts'][ti, 0]][()]\\n                    ft = f[vbot['frameTimes'][ti, 0]][()].flatten()\\n                    bot_trials_data[ti] = (ts, ft)\\n                except Exception:\\n                    pass\\n\\n            bot_cam = {'feat_names': feat_names, 'trials_data': bot_trials_data}\\n        except Exception as e:\\n            print(f\\\"  WARNING: DLC bottom cam: {e}\\\")\\n\\n        # side cam frameTimes\\n        try:\\n            vside_ref = traj[0, 0]\\n            vside = f[vside_ref]\\n            for ti in range(n_trials):\\n                try:\\n                    side_ft[ti] = f[vside['frameTimes'][ti, 0]][()].flatten()\\n                except Exception:\\n                    pass\\n        except Exception as e:\\n            print(f\\\"  WARNING: side cam frameTimes: {e}\\\")\\n\\n    return {\\n        'n_trials': n_trials, 'hit': hit, 'miss': miss, 'early': early,\\n        'no_resp': no_resp, 'L': L, 'R': R, 'autowater': autowater,\\n        'stim_en': stim_en, 'goCue': goCue, 'vidshift': vidshift,\\n        'spike_data': spike_data, 'bot_cam': bot_cam, 'side_ft': side_ft,\\n    }\\n\\n\\ndef process_session(sess, data_dir):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Process one recording session. Returns (result_dict, error_msg).\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n    anm, date = sess['anm'], sess['date']\\n    sname = f\\\"{anm}_{date}\\\"\\n    data_path = os.path.join(data_dir, sess['dir'],\\n                             f\\\"data_structure_{sname}.mat\\\")\\n    me_path = os.path.join(data_dir, sess['dir'],\\n                           f\\\"motionEnergy_{sname}.mat\\\")\\n\\n    if not os.path.exists(data_path):\\n        return None, f\\\"File not found: {data_path}\\\"\\n\\n    print(f\\\"\\\\n{'='*60}\\\")\\n    print(f\\\"Processing: {sname}  ({sess['dir']})\\\")\\n\\n    # ----------------------------------------------------------\\n    # Phase 1: Load data (auto-detect HDF5 vs v5)\\n    # ----------------------------------------------------------\\n    if _is_hdf5(data_path):\\n        sd = _load_session_h5(data_path, sess)\\n    else:\\n        sd = _load_session_v5(data_path, sess)\\n\\n    n_trials = sd['n_trials']\\n    hit, miss, early = sd['hit'], sd['miss'], sd['early']\\n    no_resp = sd['no_resp']\\n    L, R = sd['L'], sd['R']\\n    autowater, stim_en = sd['autowater'], sd['stim_en']\\n    goCue = sd['goCue']\\n    vidshift = sd['vidshift']\\n    spike_data = sd['spike_data']\\n    bot_cam = sd['bot_cam']\\n    side_ft = sd['side_ft']\\n\\n    print(f\\\"  Trials: {n_trials}  hit={hit.sum()} miss={miss.sum()} \\\"\\n          f\\\"early={early.sum()} no={no_resp.sum()} stim={stim_en.sum()} \\\"\\n          f\\\"WC={autowater.sum()}\\\")\\n\\n    # trial filter: (hit|miss) & ~stim & ~early\\n    use = ((hit == 1) | (miss == 1)) & (stim_en == 0) & (early == 0)\\n    trial_idx = np.where(use)[0]\\n\\n    if len(trial_idx) < MIN_TRIALS:\\n        return None, f\\\"Only {len(trial_idx)} usable trials\\\"\\n\\n    n_raw = len(spike_data)\\n    if n_raw < MIN_UNITS:\\n        return None, f\\\"Only {n_raw} neurons\\\"\\n\\n    # --- bin spikes, smooth (getSeq.m) ---\\n    fr = np.zeros((n_raw, T_BINS, n_trials), dtype=np.float32)\\n    for ni, spk in enumerate(spike_data):\\n        for ti in range(n_trials):\\n            mask = spk['trial'] == (ti + 1)\\n            if not np.any(mask):\\n                continue\\n            aligned = spk['trialtm'][mask] - goCue[ti]\\n            counts, _ = np.histogram(aligned, bins=EDGES)\\n            fr[ni, :, ti] = causal_smooth(counts.astype(np.float64) / DT)\\n\\n    # --- remove low FR (removeLowFRClusters.m) ---\\n    mean_fr = np.mean(fr, axis=(1, 2))\\n    keep = mean_fr > LOW_FR\\n    fr = fr[keep]\\n    n_neurons = int(keep.sum())\\n    print(f\\\"  Neurons: {n_raw} → {n_neurons}  (FR filter)\\\")\\n\\n    if n_neurons < MIN_UNITS:\\n        return None, f\\\"Only {n_neurons} neurons after FR filter\\\"\\n\\n    # --- DLC velocities (bottom cam) ---\\n    tongue_vel = np.zeros((T_BINS, n_trials), dtype=np.float32)\\n    paw_vel    = np.zeros((T_BINS, n_trials), dtype=np.float32)\\n\\n    if bot_cam is not None:\\n        try:\\n            feat_names = bot_cam['feat_names']\\n            tongue_fi = feat_names.index('top_tongue') if 'top_tongue' in feat_names else 0\\n            paw_fi = -1\\n            for pname in ['top_paw', 'bottom_paw']:\\n                if pname in feat_names:\\n                    paw_fi = feat_names.index(pname)\\n                    break\\n\\n            for ti in range(n_trials):\\n                try:\\n                    if 'get_trial' in bot_cam:\\n                        # v5 format\\n                        ts, ft = bot_cam['get_trial'](ti)\\n                        # ts shape: (nframes, 3, nfeat)\\n                        t_spd = compute_speed(\\n                            ts[:, 0, tongue_fi], ts[:, 1, tongue_fi], ft,\\n                            ts[:, 2, tongue_fi], DLC_CONF, fill_missing=True)\\n                    else:\\n                        # h5 format - ts shape: (nfeat, 3, nframes)\\n                        if ti not in bot_cam['trials_data']:\\n                            continue\\n                        ts, ft = bot_cam['trials_data'][ti]\\n                        t_spd = compute_speed(\\n                            ts[tongue_fi, 0], ts[tongue_fi, 1], ft,\\n                            ts[tongue_fi, 2], DLC_CONF, fill_missing=True)\\n\\n                    aln = ft - vidshift - goCue[ti]\\n                    interp_fn = interp1d(aln, t_spd, kind='linear',\\n                                         bounds_error=False, fill_value=np.nan)\\n                    tongue_vel[:, ti] = fill_nan_nearest(interp_fn(TIME_AXIS))\\n\\n                    # ============================================================\\\\n# HELPER FUNCTIONS\\\\n# ============================================================\\\\n\\\\ndef gausswin(N, alpha=2.5):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"MATLAB-equivalent gausswin(N, alpha).\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    if N == 1:\\\\n        return np.array([1.0])\\\\n    n = np.arange(N)\\\\n    n_norm = 2 * n / (N - 1) - 1\\\\n    return np.exp(-0.5 * (alpha * n_norm) ** 2)\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef causal_smooth(x, N=SMOOTH_N, bctype=BC_TYPE):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Causal Gaussian smoothing matching mySmooth.m.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    if N <= 1:\\\\n        return x.copy()\\\\n    kern = gausswin(N)\\\\n    kern[:N // 2] = 0   # causal: zero out first half\\\\n    kern /= compute_speed(x, y, ft, confidence=None, conf_thresh=DLC_CONF,\\\\n                  fill_missing=False):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Compute instantaneous speed from (x, y) trajectory.\\\\n\\\\n    Parameters\\\\n    ----------\\\\n    x, y : 1-D arrays of position\\\\n    ft : 1-D array of frame times (seconds)\\\\n    confidence : optional DLC confidence per frame\\\\n    conf_thresh : confidence threshold\\\\n    fill_missing : if True, fill low-confidence positions with nearest valid\\\\n                   (for paw). causal: zero out first half\\n    kern /= kern.sum()\\n\\n    if bctype == 'reflect':\\n        x_padded = np.concatenate([x[:N], x])\\n        trim = N\\n    elif bctype == 'zeropad':\\n        x_padded = np.concatenate([np.zeros(N), x])\\n        trim = N\\n    else:\\n        x_padded = x.copy()\\n        trim = 0\\n\\n    out = np.convolve(x_padded, kern, mode='same')\\n    return out[trim:]\\n\\n\\ndef h5str(f, ref):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Read string from HDF5 object reference.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    data = f[ref][()].flatten()\\n    return ''.join(chr(int(c)) for c in data)\\n\\n\\ndef fill_nan_nearest(arr):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Fill NaN values with nearest non-NaN, matching MATLAB fillmissing('nearest').\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    nans = np.isnan(arr)\\n    if not np.any(nans):\\n        return arr\\n    if np.all(nans):\\n        arr[:] = 0\\n        return arr\\n    valid_idx = np.where(~nans)[0]\\n    f_interp = interp1d(valid_idx, arr[valid_idx], kind='nearest',\\n                        fill_value='extrapolate', bounds_error=False)\\n    arr[nans] = f_interp(np.where(nans)[0])\\n    return arr\\n\\n\\ndef compute_mode(arr):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Compute statistical mode.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    arr = arr[~np.isnan(arr)]\\n    if len(arr) == 0:\\n        return 0.0\\n    vals, counts = np.unique(arr, return_counts=True)\\n    return float(vals[np.argmax(counts)])\\n\\n\\ndef compute_speed(x, y, ft, confidence=None, conf_thresh=DLC_CONF,\\n                  fill_missing=False):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Compute instantaneous speed from (x, y) trajectory.\\n\\n    Parameters\\n    ----------\\n    x, y : 1-D arrays of position\\n    ft : 1-D array of frame times (seconds)\\n    confidence : optional DLC confidence per frame\\n    conf_thresh : confidence threshold\\n    fill_missing : if True, fill low-confidence positions with nearest valid\\n                   (for paw). If False, zero speed at low confidence (for tongue).\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    x = x.copy().astype(np.float64)\\n    y = y.copy().astype(np.float64)\\n\\n    if fill_missing and confidence is not None:\\n        valid = confidence >= conf_thresh\\n        if np.any(valid) and np.any(~valid):\\n            valid_idx = np.where(valid)[0]\\n            for arr in [x, y]:\\n                bad_idx = np.where(~valid)[0]\\n                nearest = np.searchsorted(valid_idx, bad_idx).clip(0, len(valid_idx) - 1)\\n                arr[bad_idx] = arr[valid_idx[nearest]]\\n\\n    dt_vid = np.diff(ft)\\n    dt_vid[dt_vid <= 0] = 1.0 / 400.0  # default to 400 Hz\\n\\n    vx = np.diff(x) / dt_vid\\n    vy = np.diff(y) / dt_vid\\n    speed = np.sqrt(vx**2 + vy**2)\\n    speed = np.concatenate([[0.0], speed])\\n\\n    if confidence is not None and not fill_missing:\\n        speed[confidence < conf_thresh] = 0.0\\n\\n    return speed\\n\\n\\n# ============================================================\\n# SESSION PROCESSING\\n# ============================================================\\n\\ndef process_session(sess, data_dir):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Process one recording session. ============================================================\\\\n# HELPER FUNCTIONS\\\\n# ============================================================\\\\n\\\\ndef gausswin(N, alpha=2.5):\\\\n              fill_missing=True):\\n   204→    \\\"\\\"\\\"Compute instantaneous speed from (x, y) trajectory.\\n   205→\\n   206→    For all features, fills NaN/low-confidence positions with nearest valid\\n   207→    position before computing velocity, matching the paper's processing for\\n   208→    kinematic features. For tongue, positions are NaN when not visible; filling\\n   209→    gives near-zero velocity during non-licking periods and meaningful velocity\\n   210→    during licking.\\n   211→    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n   212→    x = x.copy().astype(np.float64)\\n   213→    y = y.copy().astype(np.float64)\\n   214→\\n   215→    # Determine valid frames: not NaN and (optionally) high confidence\\n   216→    valid = ~np.isnan(x) & ~np.isnan(y)\\n   217→    if confidence is not None:\\n   218→        valid = valid & (confidence >= conf_thresh)\\n   219→\\n   220→    if np.any(valid) and not np.all(valid):\\n   221→        x, y = fill_positions_nearest(x, y, valid)\\n   222→    elif not np.any(valid):\\n   223→        return np.zeros(len(x))\\n   224→\\n   225→    # Remove remaining NaN (shouldn't happen after fill, but safety)\\n   226→    x = np.nan_to_num(x, nan=0.0)\\n   227→    y = np.nan_to_num(y, nan=0.0)\\n   228→\\n   229→    dt_vid = np.diff(ft)\\n   230→    dt_vid[dt_vid <= 0] = 1.0 / 400.0\\n   231→\\n   232→    vx = np.diff(x) / dt_vid\\n   233→    vy = np.diff(y) / dt_vid\\n   234→    speed = np.sqrt(vx**2 + vy**2)\\n   235→    speed = np.concatenate([[0.0], speed])\\n   236→\\n   237→    return speed\\n   238→\\n   239→\\n   240→# ============================================================\\n   241→# SESSION PROCESSING\\n   242→# ============================================================\\n   243→\\n   244→def process_session(sess, data_dir):\\n   245→    \\\"\\\"\\\"Process one recording session. Returns (result_dict, error_msg).\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n   246→\\n   247→    anm, date = sess['anm'], sess['date']\\n   248→    sname = f\\\"{anm}_{date}\\\"\\n   249→    data_path = os.path.join(data_dir, sess['dir'],\\n   250→                             f\\\"data_structure_{sname}.mat\\\")\\n   251→    me_path = os.path.join(data_dir, sess['dir'],\\n   252→                           f\\\"motionEnergy_{sname}.mat\\\")\\n   253→\\n   254→    if not os.path.exists(data_path):\\n   255→        return None, f\\\"File not found: {data_path}\\\"\\n   256→\\n   257→    print(f\\\"\\\\n{'='*60}\\\")\\n   258→    print(f\\\"Processing: {sname}  ({sess['dir']})\\\")\\n   259→\\n   260→    # trial filter: (hit|miss) & ~stim & ~early\\n   284→        use = ((hit == 1) | (miss == 1)) & (stim_en == 0) & (early == 0)\\n   285→        trial_idx = np.where(use)[0]\\n   286→\\n   287→        if len(trial_idx) < MIN_TRIALS:\\n   288→            return None, f\\\"Only {len(trial_idx)} usable trials\\\"\\n   289→\\n   290→        # MATLAB 1-indexed trials\\n   349→                if not np.any(mask):\\n   350→                    continue\\n   351→                aligned = spk['trialtm'][mask] - goCue[ti]\\n   352→                counts, _ = np.histogram(aligned, bins=EDGES)\\n   353→                fr[ni, :, ti] = causal_smooth(counts.astype(np.float64) / DT)\\n   354→\\n   355→        # (nfeat, 3, nframes)\\n   389→                    ft = f[vbot['frameTimes'][ti, 0]][()].flatten()\\n   390→\\n   391→                    # tongue (fill NaN positions with nearest valid)\\n   392→                    t_spd = compute_speed(\\n   393→                        ts[tongue_fi, 0], ts[tongue_fi, 1], ft,\\n   394→                        ts[tongue_fi, 2], DLC_CONF, fill_missing=True)\\n   395→                    aln = ft - vidshift - goCue[ti]\\n   396→                    interp_fn = interp1d(aln, t_spd, kind='linear',\\n   397→                                         bounds_error=False, fill_value=np.nan)\\n   398→                    tongue_vel[:, ti] = fill_nan_nearest(interp_fn(TIME_AXIS))\\n   399→\\n   400→                    # causal: zero out first half\\\\n    kern /= kern.sum()\\\\n\\\\n    if bctype == 'reflect':\\\\n        x_padded = np.concatenate([x[:N], x])\\\\n        trim = N\\\\n    elif bctype == 'zeropad':\\\\n        x_padded = np.concatenate([np.zeros(N), x])\\\\n        trim = N\\\\n    else:\\\\n        x_padded = x.copy()\\\\n        trim = 0\\\\n\\\\n    out = np.convolve(x_padded, kern, mode='same')\\\\n    return out[trim:]\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef h5str(f, ref):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Read string from HDF5 object reference.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    data = f[ref][()].flatten()\\\\n    return ''.join(chr(int(c)) for c in data)\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef fill_nan_nearest(arr):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Fill NaN values with nearest non-NaN, matching MATLAB fillmissing('nearest').\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    nans = np.isnan(arr)\\\\n    if not np.any(nans):\\\\n        return arr\\\\n    if np.all(nans):\\\\n        arr[:] = 0\\\\n        return arr\\\\n    valid_idx = np.where(~nans)[0]\\\\n    f_interp = interp1d(valid_idx, arr[valid_idx], kind='nearest',\\\\n                        fill_value='extrapolate', bounds_error=False)\\\\n    arr[nans] = f_interp(np.where(nans)[0])\\\\n    return arr\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef compute_mode(arr):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Compute statistical mode.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    arr = arr[~np.isnan(arr)]\\\\n    if len(arr) == 0:\\\\n        return 0.0\\\\n    vals, counts = np.unique(arr, return_counts=True)\\\\n    return float(vals[np.argmax(counts)])\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef fill_positions_nearest(x, y, valid_mask):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Fill invalid positions with nearest valid values.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    x, y = x.copy(), y.copy()\\\\n    if not np.any(valid_mask) or np.all(valid_mask):\\\\n        return x, y\\\\n    valid_idx = np.where(valid_mask)[0]\\\\n    bad_idx = np.where(~valid_mask)[0]\\\\n    nearest = np.searchsorted(valid_idx, bad_idx).clip(0, len(valid_idx) - 1)\\\\n    # Check left neighbor too for true nearest\\\\n    left = np.clip(nearest - 1, 0, len(valid_idx) - 1)\\\\n    d_right = np.abs(bad_idx - valid_idx[nearest])\\\\n    d_left = np.abs(bad_idx - valid_idx[left])\\\\n    use_left = d_left < d_right\\\\n    final = np.where(use_left, left, nearest)\\\\n    x[bad_idx] = x[valid_idx[final]]\\\\n    y[bad_idx] = y[valid_idx[final]]\\\\n    return x, y\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef compute_speed(x, y, ft, confidence=None, conf_thresh=DLC_CONF,\\\\n                  fill_missing=True):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Compute instantaneous speed from (x, y) trajectory.\\\\n\\\\n    For all features, fills NaN/low-confidence positions with nearest valid\\\\n    position before computing velocity, matching the paper's processing for\\\\n    kinematic features. For tongue, positions are NaN when not visible; filling\\\\n    gives near-zero velocity during non-licking periods and meaningful velocity\\\\n    during licking.\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    x = x.copy().astype(np.float64)\\\\n    y = y.copy().astype(np.float64)\\\\n\\\\n    # Determine valid frames: not NaN and (optionally) high confidence\\\\n    valid = ~np.isnan(x) & ~np.isnan(y)\\\\n    if confidence is not None:\\\\n        valid = valid & (confidence >= conf_thresh)\\\\n\\\\n    if np.any(valid) and not np.all(valid):\\\\n        x, y = fill_positions_nearest(x, y, valid)\\\\n    elif not np.any(valid):\\\\n        return np.zeros(len(x))\\\\n\\\\n    # Remove remaining NaN (shouldn't happen after fill, but safety)\\\\n    x = np.nan_to_num(x, nan=0.0)\\\\n    y = np.nan_to_num(y, nan=0.0)\\\\n\\\\n    dt_vid = np.diff(ft)\\\\n    dt_vid[dt_vid <= 0] = 1.0 / 400.0\\\\n\\\\n    vx = np.diff(x) / dt_vid\\\\n    vy = np.diff(y) / dt_vid\\\\n    speed = np.sqrt(vx**2 + vy**2)\\\\n    speed = np.concatenate([[0.0], speed])\\\\n\\\\n    return speed\\\\n\\\\n\\\\n# ============================================================\\\\n# SESSION PROCESSING\\\\n# ============================================================\\\\n\\\\ndef process_session(sess, data_dir):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Process one recording session. Returns (result_dict, error_msg).\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n\\\\n    anm, date = sess['anm'], sess['date']\\\\n    sname = f\\\\\\\"{anm}_{date}\\\\\\\"\\\\n    data_path = os.path.join(data_dir, sess['dir'],\\\\n                             f\\\\\\\"data_structure_{sname}.mat\\\\\\\")\\\\n    me_path = os.path.join(data_dir, sess['dir'],\\\\n                           f\\\\\\\"motionEnergy_{sname}.mat\\\\\\\")\\\\n\\\\n    if not os.path.exists(data_path):\\\\n        return None, f\\\\\\\"File not found: {data_path}\\\\\\\"\\\\n\\\\n    print(f\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\\n{'='*60}\\\\\\\")\\\\n    print(f\\\\\\\"Processing: {sname}  ({sess['dir']})\\\\\\\")\\\\n\\\\n    # trial filter: (hit|miss) & ~stim & ~early\\\\n        use = ((hit == 1) | (miss == 1)) & (stim_en == 0) & (early == 0)\\\\n        trial_idx = np.where(use)[0]\\\\n\\\\n        if len(trial_idx) < MIN_TRIALS:\\\\n            return None, f\\\\\\\"Only {len(trial_idx)} usable trials\\\\\\\"\\\\n\\\\n        # --- video offset (findVideoOffset.m) ---\\\\n        try:\\\\n            bitStart_mode = compute_mode(bp['ev']['bitStart'][0, :n_trials])\\\\n            bc_bs = obj['sglx']['bitcode']['bitstart'][0, :]\\\\n            bc_bs_mode = compute_mode(bc_bs)\\\\n            fs = float(obj['sglx']['fs'][0, 0])\\\\n            vidshift = bc_bs_mode / fs - bitStart_mode\\\\n        except Exception as e:\\\\n            print(f\\\\\\\"  WARNING: vidshift fallback 0.5 ({e})\\\\\\\")\\\\n            vidshift = 0.5\\\\n\\\\n        # --- cluster data ---\\\\n        clu_group = obj['clu']\\\\n        spike_data = []\\\\n\\\\n        for prb in sess['probes']:\\\\n            pidx = prb - 1  # MATLAB 1-based → 0-based\\\\n            try:\\\\n                prb_ref = clu_group[pidx, 0]\\\\n                prb_g = f[prb_ref]\\\\n            except Exception:\\\\n                print(f\\\\\\\"  Probe {prb}: empty\\\\\\\")\\\\n                continue\\\\n\\\\n            quality_ds = prb_g['quality']\\\\n            n_clu = quality_ds.shape[0]\\\\n\\\\n            qualities = []\\\\n            for i in range(n_clu):\\\\n                try:\\\\n                    q = h5str(f, quality_ds[i, 0]).strip()\\\\n                except Exception:\\\\n                    q = ''\\\\n                qualities.append(q)\\\\n\\\\n            valid_clu = [i for i, q in enumerate(qualities)\\\\n                         if q.lower() not in EXCLUDED_QUALITIES and q != '']\\\\n\\\\n            q_counts = {}\\\\n            for q in qualities:\\\\n                q_counts[q] = q_counts.get(q, 0) + 1\\\\n            print(f\\\\\\\"  Probe {prb}: {n_clu} total, {len(valid_clu)} valid  \\\\\\\"\\\\n                  f\\\\\\\"{q_counts}\\\\\\\")\\\\n\\\\n            for ci in valid_clu:\\\\n                spike_data.append({\\\\n                    'trial':   f[prb_g['trial'][ci, 0]][()].flatten(),\\\\n                    'trialtm': f[prb_g['trialtm'][ci, 0]][()].flatten(),\\\\n                })\\\\n\\\\n        n_raw = len(spike_data)\\\\n        if n_raw < MIN_UNITS:\\\\n            return None, f\\\\\\\"Only {n_raw} neurons\\\\\\\"\\\\n\\\\n        # --- bin spikes, smooth (getSeq.m) ---\\\\n        fr = np.zeros((n_raw, T_BINS, n_trials), dtype=np.float32)\\\\n        for ni, spk in enumerate(spike_data):\\\\n            for ti in range(n_trials):\\\\n                mask = spk['trial'] == (ti + 1)  # MATLAB 1-indexed trials\\\\n                if not np.any(mask):\\\\n                    continue\\\\n                aligned = spk['trialtm'][mask] - goCue[ti]\\\\n                counts, _ = np.histogram(aligned, bins=EDGES)\\\\n                fr[ni, :, ti] = causal_smooth(counts.astype(np.float64) / DT)\\\\n\\\\n        # --- DLC velocities (bottom cam) ---\\\\n        tongue_vel = np.zeros((T_BINS, n_trials), dtype=np.float32)\\\\n        paw_vel    = np.zeros((T_BINS, n_trials), dtype=np.float32)\\\\n\\\\n        traj = obj['traj']\\\\n        try:\\\\n            vbot_ref = traj[1, 0]\\\\n            vbot = f[vbot_ref]\\\\n\\\\n            # --- side cam frameTimes (for motion energy alignment) ---\\\\n        side_ft = {}\\\\n        try:\\\\n            vside_ref = traj[0, 0]\\\\n            vside = f[vside_ref]\\\\n            for ti in range(n_trials):\\\\n                try:\\\\n                    side_ft[ti] = f[vside['frameTimes'][ti, 0]][()].flatten()\\\\n                except Exception:\\\\n                    pass\\\\n        except Exception as e:\\\\n            print(f\\\\\\\"  WARNING: side cam frameTimes: {e}\\\\\\\")\\\\n\\\\n    # ----------------------------------------------------------\\\\n    # Phase 2: motion energy (scipy.io, separate file)\\\\n    # ----------------------------------------------------------\\\\n    me_data = np.zeros((T_BINS, n_trials), dtype=np.float32)\\\\n\\\\n    if os.path.exists(me_path):\\\\n        try:\\\\n            me_mat = scipy.io.loadmat(me_path, squeeze_me=False)\\\\n            me_struct = me_mat['me']\\\\n            me_trials = me_struct['data'][0, 0]\\\\n\\\\n            for ti in range(min(n_trials, me_trials.shape[0])):\\\\n                trial_me = me_trials[ti, 0].flatten().astype(np.float64)\\\\n\\\\n                if ti in side_ft:\\\\n                    aln = side_ft[ti] - vidshift - goCue[ti]\\\\n                    if len(trial_me) != len(aln):\\\\n                        aln = np.arange(len(trial_me)) / 400.0 - 0.5 - goCue[ti]\\\\n                else:\\\\n                    aln = np.arange(len(trial_me)) / 400.0 - 0.5 - goCue[ti]\\\\n\\\\n                interp_fn = interp1d(aln, trial_me, kind='linear',\\\\n                                     bounds_error=False, fill_value=np.nan)\\\\n                me_data[:, ti] = fill_nan_nearest(interp_fn(TIME_AXIS))\\\\n\\\\n            print(f\\\\\\\"  Loaded motion energy\\\\\\\")\\\\n        except Exception as e:\\\\n            print(f\\\\\\\"  WARNING: motion energy: {e}\\\\\\\")\\\\n    else:\\\\n        print(f\\\\\\\"  WARNING: no motion energy file\\\\\\\")\\\\n\\\\n    # ----------------------------------------------------------\\\\n    # Phase 3: assemble trials\\\\n    # ----------------------------------------------------------\\\\n    # Per-session 50th percentile thresholds for discretization\\\\n    # causal: zero out first half\\n    kern /= kern.sum()\\n\\n    if bctype == 'reflect':\\n        x_padded = np.concatenate([x[:N], x])\\n        trim = N\\n    elif bctype == 'zeropad':\\n        x_padded = np.concatenate([np.zeros(N), x])\\n        trim = N\\n    else:\\n        x_padded = x.copy()\\n        trim = 0\\n\\n    out = np.convolve(x_padded, kern, mode='same')\\n    return out[trim:]\\n\\n\\ndef h5str(f, ref):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Read string from HDF5 object reference.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    data = f[ref][()].flatten()\\n    return ''.join(chr(int(c)) for c in data)\\n\\n\\ndef fill_nan_nearest(arr):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Fill NaN values with nearest non-NaN, matching MATLAB fillmissing('nearest').\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    nans = np.isnan(arr)\\n    if not np.any(nans):\\n        return arr\\n    if np.all(nans):\\n        arr[:] = 0\\n        return arr\\n    valid_idx = np.where(~nans)[0]\\n    f_interp = interp1d(valid_idx, arr[valid_idx], kind='nearest',\\n                        fill_value='extrapolate', bounds_error=False)\\n    arr[nans] = f_interp(np.where(nans)[0])\\n    return arr\\n\\n\\ndef compute_mode(arr):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Compute statistical mode.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    arr = arr[~np.isnan(arr)]\\n    if len(arr) == 0:\\n        return 0.0\\n    vals, counts = np.unique(arr, return_counts=True)\\n    return float(vals[np.argmax(counts)])\\n\\n\\ndef fill_positions_nearest(x, y, valid_mask):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Fill invalid positions with nearest valid values.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    x, y = x.copy(), y.copy()\\n    if not np.any(valid_mask) or np.all(valid_mask):\\n        return x, y\\n    valid_idx = np.where(valid_mask)[0]\\n    bad_idx = np.where(~valid_mask)[0]\\n    nearest = np.searchsorted(valid_idx, bad_idx).clip(0, len(valid_idx) - 1)\\n    # Check left neighbor too for true nearest\\n    left = np.clip(nearest - 1, 0, len(valid_idx) - 1)\\n    d_right = np.abs(bad_idx - valid_idx[nearest])\\n    d_left = np.abs(bad_idx - valid_idx[left])\\n    use_left = d_left < d_right\\n    final = np.where(use_left, left, nearest)\\n    x[bad_idx] = x[valid_idx[final]]\\n    y[bad_idx] = y[valid_idx[final]]\\n    return x, y\\n\\n\\ndef compute_speed(x, y, ft, confidence=None, conf_thresh=DLC_CONF,\\n                  fill_missing=True):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Compute instantaneous speed from (x, y) trajectory.\\n\\n    For all features, fills NaN/low-confidence positions with nearest valid\\n    position before computing velocity, matching the paper's processing for\\n    kinematic features. For tongue, positions are NaN when not visible; filling\\n    gives near-zero velocity during non-licking periods and meaningful velocity\\n    during licking.\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    x = x.copy().astype(np.float64)\\n    y = y.copy().astype(np.float64)\\n\\n    # Determine valid frames: not NaN and (optionally) high confidence\\n    valid = ~np.isnan(x) & ~np.isnan(y)\\n    if confidence is not None:\\n        valid = valid & (confidence >= conf_thresh)\\n\\n    if np.any(valid) and not np.all(valid):\\n        x, y = fill_positions_nearest(x, y, valid)\\n    elif not np.any(valid):\\n        return np.zeros(len(x))\\n\\n    # Remove remaining NaN (shouldn't happen after fill, but safety)\\n    x = np.nan_to_num(x, nan=0.0)\\n    y = np.nan_to_num(y, nan=0.0)\\n\\n    dt_vid = np.diff(ft)\\n    dt_vid[dt_vid <= 0] = 1.0 / 400.0\\n\\n    vx = np.diff(x) / dt_vid\\n    vy = np.diff(y) / dt_vid\\n    speed = np.sqrt(vx**2 + vy**2)\\n    speed = np.concatenate([[0.0], speed])\\n\\n    return speed\\n\\n\\n# ============================================================\\n# SESSION PROCESSING\\n# ============================================================\\n\\ndef _is_hdf5(path):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Check if a .mat file is HDF5 (MATLAB v7.3) format.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    try:\\n        with open(path, 'rb') as fp:\\n            header = fp.read(4)\\n        return header == b'\\\\x89HDF'\\n    except Exception:\\n        return False\\n\\n\\ndef _load_session_v5(data_path, sess):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Load session data from MATLAB v5 format into common dict.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    d = scipy.io.loadmat(data_path)\\n    obj = d['obj']\\n    bp = obj['bp'][0, 0]\\n\\n    n_trials = int(bp['Ntrials'][0, 0])\\n    hit = bp['hit'][0, 0].flatten()[:n_trials].astype(int)\\n    miss = bp['miss'][0, 0].flatten()[:n_trials].astype(int)\\n    early = bp['early'][0, 0].flatten()[:n_trials].astype(int)\\n    no_resp = bp['no'][0, 0].flatten()[:n_trials].astype(int)\\n    L = bp['L'][0, 0].flatten()[:n_trials].astype(int)\\n    R = bp['R'][0, 0].flatten()[:n_trials].astype(int)\\n    autowater = bp['autowater'][0, 0].flatten()[:n_trials].astype(int)\\n\\n    stim = bp['stim'][0, 0]\\n    stim_en_raw = stim['enable'][0, 0]\\n    if stim_en_raw.ndim >= 2:\\n        stim_en = stim_en_raw.flatten()[:n_trials].astype(int)\\n    else:\\n        stim_en = stim_en_raw.flatten()[:n_trials].astype(int)\\n\\n    ev = bp['ev'][0, 0]\\n    goCue = ev['goCue'][0, 0].flatten()[:n_trials].astype(float)\\n\\n    # video offset\\n    try:\\n        bitStart_vals = ev['bitStart'][0, 0].flatten()[:n_trials].astype(float)\\n        bitStart_mode = compute_mode(bitStart_vals)\\n        sglx = obj['sglx'][0, 0]\\n        bc = sglx['bitcode'][0, 0]\\n        bc_bs = bc['bitstart'][0, 0].flatten().astype(float)\\n        bc_bs_mode = compute_mode(bc_bs)\\n        fs = float(sglx['fs'][0, 0])\\n        vidshift = bc_bs_mode / fs - bitStart_mode\\n    except Exception as e:\\n        vidshift = 0.5\\n\\n    # cluster data\\n    clu_cell = obj['clu'][0, 0]  # (1, nProbes) object array\\n    spike_data = []\\n    for prb in sess['probes']:\\n        pidx = prb - 1\\n        try:\\n            probe_arr = clu_cell[0, pidx]  # struct array (1, nClusters)\\n        except Exception:\\n            print(f\\\"  Probe {prb}: empty\\\")\\n            continue\\n        n_clu = probe_arr.shape[1]\\n        qualities = []\\n        for i in range(n_clu):\\n            q = str(probe_arr['quality'][0, i].item()).strip()\\n            qualities.append(q)\\n\\n        valid_clu = [i for i, q in enumerate(qualities)\\n                     if q.lower() not in EXCLUDED_QUALITIES and q != '']\\n        q_counts = {}\\n        for q in qualities:\\n            q_counts[q] = q_counts.get(q, 0) + 1\\n        print(f\\\"  Probe {prb}: {n_clu} total, {len(valid_clu)} valid  {q_counts}\\\")\\n\\n        for ci in valid_clu:\\n            spike_data.append({\\n                'trial': probe_arr['trial'][0, ci].flatten().astype(float),\\n                'trialtm': probe_arr['trialtm'][0, ci].flatten().astype(float),\\n            })\\n\\n    # DLC bottom cam\\n    traj_cell = obj['traj'][0, 0]  # (1, 2) for [side, bottom]\\n    bot_cam = None\\n    try:\\n        bot_arr = traj_cell[0, 1]  # struct array (1, nTrials)\\n        # feature names from first trial\\n        fn_raw = bot_arr[0, 0]['featNames']\\n        feat_names = []\\n        for i in range(fn_raw.shape[0]):\\n            try:\\n                feat_names.append(str(fn_raw[i, 0].item()))\\n            except Exception:\\n                feat_names.append(str(fn_raw[i].item()))\\n        if not feat_names:\\n            for i in range(fn_raw.shape[1]):\\n                feat_names.append(str(fn_raw[0, i].item()))\\n\\n        bot_cam = {'feat_names': feat_names, 'n_cam_trials': bot_arr.shape[1]}\\n\\n        def get_bot_trial(ti):\\n            t = bot_arr[0, ti]\\n            ts = t['ts'].astype(float)  # (nframes, 3, nfeat)\\n            ft = t['frameTimes'].flatten().astype(float)\\n            return ts, ft\\n\\n        bot_cam['get_trial'] = get_bot_trial\\n    except Exception as e:\\n        print(f\\\"  WARNING: DLC bottom cam: {e}\\\")\\n\\n    # side cam frameTimes\\n    side_ft = {}\\n    try:\\n        side_arr = traj_cell[0, 0]\\n        for ti in range(min(n_trials, side_arr.shape[1])):\\n            try:\\n                side_ft[ti] = side_arr[0, ti]['frameTimes'].flatten().astype(float)\\n            except Exception:\\n                pass\\n    except Exception as e:\\n        print(f\\\"  WARNING: side cam frameTimes: {e}\\\")\\n\\n    return {\\n        'n_trials': n_trials, 'hit': hit, 'miss': miss, 'early': early,\\n        'no_resp': no_resp, 'L': L, 'R': R, 'autowater': autowater,\\n        'stim_en': stim_en, 'goCue': goCue, 'vidshift': vidshift,\\n        'spike_data': spike_data, 'bot_cam': bot_cam, 'side_ft': side_ft,\\n    }\\n\\n\\ndef _load_session_h5(data_path, sess):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Load session data from HDF5 (v7.3) format into common dict.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    spike_data = []\\n    bot_cam = None\\n    side_ft = {}\\n\\n    with h5py.File(data_path, 'r') as f:\\n        obj = f['obj']\\n        bp = obj['bp']\\n\\n        n_trials = int(bp['Ntrials'][0, 0])\\n        hit   = bp['hit'][0, :n_trials].astype(int)\\n        miss  = bp['miss'][0, :n_trials].astype(int)\\n        early = bp['early'][0, :n_trials].astype(int)\\n        no_resp = bp['no'][0, :n_trials].astype(int)\\n        L     = bp['L'][0, :n_trials].astype(int)\\n        R     = bp['R'][0, :n_trials].astype(int)\\n        autowater = bp['autowater'][0, :n_trials].astype(int)\\n        stim_en   = bp['stim']['enable'][0, :n_trials].astype(int)\\n        goCue     = bp['ev']['goCue'][0, :n_trials].copy()\\n\\n        # video offset\\n        try:\\n            bitStart_mode = compute_mode(bp['ev']['bitStart'][0, :n_trials])\\n            bc_bs = obj['sglx']['bitcode']['bitstart'][0, :]\\n            bc_bs_mode = compute_mode(bc_bs)\\n            fs = float(obj['sglx']['fs'][0, 0])\\n            vidshift = bc_bs_mode / fs - bitStart_mode\\n        except Exception as e:\\n            vidshift = 0.5\\n\\n        # cluster data\\n        clu_group = obj['clu']\\n        for prb in sess['probes']:\\n            pidx = prb - 1\\n            try:\\n                prb_ref = clu_group[pidx, 0]\\n                prb_g = f[prb_ref]\\n            except Exception:\\n                print(f\\\"  Probe {prb}: empty\\\")\\n                continue\\n\\n            quality_ds = prb_g['quality']\\n            n_clu = quality_ds.shape[0]\\n            qualities = []\\n            for i in range(n_clu):\\n                try:\\n                    q = h5str(f, quality_ds[i, 0]).strip()\\n                except Exception:\\n                    q = ''\\n                qualities.append(q)\\n\\n            valid_clu = [i for i, q in enumerate(qualities)\\n                         if q.lower() not in EXCLUDED_QUALITIES and q != '']\\n            q_counts = {}\\n            for q in qualities:\\n                q_counts[q] = q_counts.get(q, 0) + 1\\n            print(f\\\"  Probe {prb}: {n_clu} total, {len(valid_clu)} valid  {q_counts}\\\")\\n\\n            for ci in valid_clu:\\n                spike_data.append({\\n                    'trial':   f[prb_g['trial'][ci, 0]][()].flatten(),\\n                    'trialtm': f[prb_g['trialtm'][ci, 0]][()].flatten(),\\n                })\\n\\n        # DLC bottom cam - read all trial data into memory\\n        traj = obj['traj']\\n        bot_trials_data = {}\\n        try:\\n            vbot_ref = traj[1, 0]\\n            vbot = f[vbot_ref]\\n            fn_ref = vbot['featNames'][0, 0]\\n            fn_arr = f[fn_ref][:]\\n            feat_names = [h5str(f, fn_arr[0, i]) for i in range(fn_arr.shape[1])]\\n\\n            for ti in range(n_trials):\\n                try:\\n                    ts = f[vbot['ts'][ti, 0]][()]\\n                    ft = f[vbot['frameTimes'][ti, 0]][()].flatten()\\n                    bot_trials_data[ti] = (ts, ft)\\n                except Exception:\\n                    pass\\n\\n            bot_cam = {'feat_names': feat_names, 'trials_data': bot_trials_data}\\n        except Exception as e:\\n            print(f\\\"  WARNING: DLC bottom cam: {e}\\\")\\n\\n        # side cam frameTimes\\n        try:\\n            vside_ref = traj[0, 0]\\n            vside = f[vside_ref]\\n            for ti in range(n_trials):\\n                try:\\n                    side_ft[ti] = f[vside['frameTimes'][ti, 0]][()].flatten()\\n                except Exception:\\n                    pass\\n        except Exception as e:\\n            print(f\\\"  WARNING: side cam frameTimes: {e}\\\")\\n\\n    return {\\n        'n_trials': n_trials, 'hit': hit, 'miss': miss, 'early': early,\\n        'no_resp': no_resp, 'L': L, 'R': R, 'autowater': autowater,\\n        'stim_en': stim_en, 'goCue': goCue, 'vidshift': vidshift,\\n        'spike_data': spike_data, 'bot_cam': bot_cam, 'side_ft': side_ft,\\n    }\\n\\n\\ndef process_session(sess, data_dir):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Process one recording session. Returns (result_dict, error_msg).\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n    anm, date = sess['anm'], sess['date']\\n    sname = f\\\"{anm}_{date}\\\"\\n    data_path = os.path.join(data_dir, sess['dir'],\\n                             f\\\"data_structure_{sname}.mat\\\")\\n    me_path = os.path.join(data_dir, sess['dir'],\\n                           f\\\"motionEnergy_{sname}.mat\\\")\\n\\n    if not os.path.exists(data_path):\\n        return None, f\\\"File not found: {data_path}\\\"\\n\\n    print(f\\\"\\\\n{'='*60}\\\")\\n    print(f\\\"Processing: {sname}  ({sess['dir']})\\\")\\n\\n    # ----------------------------------------------------------\\n    # Phase 1: Load data (auto-detect HDF5 vs v5)\\n    # ----------------------------------------------------------\\n    if _is_hdf5(data_path):\\n        sd = _load_session_h5(data_path, sess)\\n    else:\\n        sd = _load_session_v5(data_path, sess)\\n\\n    n_trials = sd['n_trials']\\n    hit, miss, early = sd['hit'], sd['miss'], sd['early']\\n    no_resp = sd['no_resp']\\n    L, R = sd['L'], sd['R']\\n    autowater, stim_en = sd['autowater'], sd['stim_en']\\n    goCue = sd['goCue']\\n    vidshift = sd['vidshift']\\n    spike_data = sd['spike_data']\\n    bot_cam = sd['bot_cam']\\n    side_ft = sd['side_ft']\\n\\n    print(f\\\"  Trials: {n_trials}  hit={hit.sum()} miss={miss.sum()} \\\"\\n          f\\\"early={early.sum()} no={no_resp.sum()} stim={stim_en.sum()} \\\"\\n          f\\\"WC={autowater.sum()}\\\")\\n\\n    # trial filter: (hit|miss) & ~stim & ~early\\n    use = ((hit == 1) | (miss == 1)) & (stim_en == 0) & (early == 0)\\n    trial_idx = np.where(use)[0]\\n\\n    if len(trial_idx) < MIN_TRIALS:\\n        return None, f\\\"Only {len(trial_idx)} usable trials\\\"\\n\\n    n_raw = len(spike_data)\\n    if n_raw < MIN_UNITS:\\n        return None, f\\\"Only {n_raw} neurons\\\"\\n\\n    # --- bin spikes, smooth (getSeq.m) ---\\n    fr = np.zeros((n_raw, T_BINS, n_trials), dtype=np.float32)\\n    for ni, spk in enumerate(spike_data):\\n        for ti in range(n_trials):\\n            mask = spk['trial'] == (ti + 1)\\n            if not np.any(mask):\\n                continue\\n            aligned = spk['trialtm'][mask] - goCue[ti]\\n            counts, _ = np.histogram(aligned, bins=EDGES)\\n            fr[ni, :, ti] = causal_smooth(counts.astype(np.float64) / DT)\\n\\n    # --- remove low FR (removeLowFRClusters.m) ---\\n    mean_fr = np.mean(fr, axis=(1, 2))\\n    keep = mean_fr > LOW_FR\\n    fr = fr[keep]\\n    n_neurons = int(keep.sum())\\n    print(f\\\"  Neurons: {n_raw} → {n_neurons}  (FR filter)\\\")\\n\\n    if n_neurons < MIN_UNITS:\\n        return None, f\\\"Only {n_neurons} neurons after FR filter\\\"\\n\\n    # --- DLC velocities (bottom cam) ---\\n    tongue_vel = np.zeros((T_BINS, n_trials), dtype=np.float32)\\n    paw_vel    = np.zeros((T_BINS, n_trials), dtype=np.float32)\\n\\n    if bot_cam is not None:\\n        try:\\n            feat_names = bot_cam['feat_names']\\n            tongue_fi = feat_names.index('top_tongue') if 'top_tongue' in feat_names else 0\\n            paw_fi = -1\\n            for pname in ['top_paw', 'bottom_paw']:\\n                if pname in feat_names:\\n                    paw_fi = feat_names.index(pname)\\n                    break\\n\\n            for ti in range(n_trials):\\n                try:\\n                    if 'get_trial' in bot_cam:\\n                        # v5 format\\n                        ts, ft = bot_cam['get_trial'](ti)\\n                        # ts shape: (nframes, 3, nfeat)\\n                        t_spd = compute_speed(\\n                            ts[:, 0, tongue_fi], ts[:, 1, tongue_fi], ft,\\n                            ts[:, 2, tongue_fi], DLC_CONF, fill_missing=True)\\n                    else:\\n                        # h5 format - ts shape: (nfeat, 3, nframes)\\n                        if ti not in bot_cam['trials_data']:\\n                            continue\\n                        ts, ft = bot_cam['trials_data'][ti]\\n                        t_spd = compute_speed(\\n                            ts[tongue_fi, 0], ts[tongue_fi, 1], ft,\\n                            ts[tongue_fi, 2], DLC_CONF, fill_missing=True)\\n\\n                    aln = ft - vidshift - goCue[ti]\\n                    interp_fn = interp1d(aln, t_spd, kind='linear',\\n                                         bounds_error=False, fill_value=np.nan)\\n                    tongue_vel[:, ti] = fill_nan_nearest(interp_fn(TIME_AXIS))\\n\\n                    # paw\\n                    if paw_fi >= 0:\\n                        if 'get_trial' in bot_cam:\\n                            ts_p, ft_p = ts, ft\\n                            p_spd = compute_speed(\\n                                ts_p[:, 0, paw_fi], ts_p[:, 1, paw_fi], ft_p,\\n                                ts_p[:, 2, paw_fi], DLC_CONF, fill_missing=True)\\n                        else:\\n                            if ti not in bot_cam['trials_data']:\\n                                continue\\n                            ts_p, ft_p = bot_cam['trials_data'][ti]\\n                            p_spd = compute_speed(\\n                                ts_p[paw_fi, 0], ts_p[paw_fi, 1], ft_p,\\n                                ts_p[paw_fi, 2], DLC_CONF, fill_missing=True)\\n                        interp_fn = interp1d(aln, p_spd, kind='linear',\\n                                             bounds_error=False, fill_value=np.nan)\\n                        paw_vel[:, ti] = fill_nan_nearest(interp_fn(TIME_AXIS))\\n                except Exception:\\n                    pass\\n        except Exception as e:\\n            print(f\\\"  WARNING: DLC processing: {e}\\\")\\n\\n    # ----------------------------------------------------------\\n    # Phase 2: motion energy (scipy.io, separate file)\\n    # ----------------------------------------------------------\\n    me_data = np.zeros((T_BINS, n_trials), dtype=np.float32)\\n\\n    if os.path.exists(me_path):\\n        try:\\n            me_mat = scipy.io.loadmat(me_path, squeeze_me=False)\\n            me_struct = me_mat['me']\\n            me_trials = me_struct['data'][0, 0]\\n\\n            for ti in range(min(n_trials, me_trials.shape[0])):\\n                trial_me = me_trials[ti, 0].flatten().astype(np.float64)\\n\\n                if ti in side_ft:\\n                    aln = side_ft[ti] - vidshift - goCue[ti]\\n                    if len(trial_me) != len(aln):\\n                        aln = np.arange(len(trial_me)) / 400.0 - 0.5 - goCue[ti]\\n                else:\\n                    aln = np.arange(len(trial_me)) / 400.0 - 0.5 - goCue[ti]\\n\\n                interp_fn = interp1d(aln, trial_me, kind='linear',\\n                                     bounds_error=False, fill_value=np.nan)\\n                me_data[:, ti] = fill_nan_nearest(interp_fn(TIME_AXIS))\\n\\n            print(f\\\"  Loaded motion energy\\\")\\n        except Exception as e:\\n            print(f\\\"  WARNING: motion energy: {e}\\\")\\n    else:\\n        print(f\\\"  WARNING: no motion energy file\\\")\\n\\n    # ----------------------------------------------------------\\n    # Phase 3: assemble trials\\n    # ----------------------------------------------------------\\n    # Per-session 50th percentile thresholds for discretization\\n    # For tongue: use 50th percentile of non-zero values since tongue is\\n    # only visible during licking (~4% of frames). Zero values (tongue not\\n    # visible) are automatically \\\"low\\\".\\n    tongue_usable = tongue_vel[:, trial_idx].flatten()\\n    tongue_nonzero = tongue_usable[tongue_usable > 0]\\n    if len(tongue_nonzero) > 0:\\n        tongue_thresh = np.percentile(tongue_nonzero, 50)\\n    else:\\n        tongue_thresh = 1.0  #
