JEB13\\n    {'dir': EB, 'anm': 'JEB13', 'date': '2022-09-13', 'probes': [2]},\\n    {'dir': EB, 'anm': 'JEB13', 'date': '2022-09-14', 'probes': [2]},\\n    {'dir': EB, 'anm': 'JEB13', 'date': '2022-09-21', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': EB, 'anm': 'JEB13', 'date': '2022-09-24', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': EB, 'anm': 'JEB13', 'date': '2022-09-25', 'probes': [1]},\\n    # JEB14\\n    {'dir': EB, 'anm': 'JEB14', 'date': '2022-08-22', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': EB, 'anm': 'JEB14', 'date': '2022-08-23', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': EB, 'anm': 'JEB14', 'date': '2022-08-24', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': EB, 'anm': 'JEB14', 'date': '2022-08-25', 'probes': [1]},\\n    # JEB15 - all 4 sessions per loading script (first 3 have note about\\n    # sensory area but are still included in the loading script)\\n    {'dir': EB, 'anm': 'JEB15', 'date': '2022-07-26', 'probes': [1, 2]},\\n    {'dir': EB, 'anm': 'JEB15', 'date': '2022-07-27', 'probes': [1, 2]},\\n    {'dir': EB, 'anm': 'JEB15', 'date': '2022-07-28', 'probes': [1, 2]},\\n    {'dir': EB, 'anm': 'JEB15', 'date': '2022-07-29', 'probes': [2]},\\n    # JEB19\\n    {'dir': EB, 'anm': 'JEB19', 'date': '2023-04-21', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': EB, 'anm': 'JEB19', 'date': '2023-04-20', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': EB, 'anm': 'JEB19', 'date': '2023-04-19', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': EB, 'anm': 'JEB19', 'date': '2023-04-18', 'probes': [1]},\\n    # --- RandomizedDelay_Ephys_Behavior ---\\n    # JEB11\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB11', 'date': '2022-05-10', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB11', 'date': '2022-05-11', 'probes': [1]},\\n    # JEB12\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB12', 'date': '2022-05-12', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB12', 'date': '2022-05-13', 'probes': [1]},\\n    # JEB23\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB23', 'date': '2023-10-10', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB23', 'date': '2023-10-11', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB23', 'date': '2023-10-12', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB23', 'date': '2023-10-13', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB23', 'date': '2023-10-18', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB23', 'date': '2023-10-19', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB23', 'date': '2023-10-21', 'probes': [1]},\\n    # JEB24\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB24', 'date': '2023-10-23', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB24', 'date': '2023-10-24', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB24', 'date': '2023-10-25', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB24', 'date': '2023-10-26', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB24', 'date': '2023-10-27', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB24', 'date': '2023-10-31', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB24', 'date': '2023-11-02', 'probes': [1]},\\n    {'dir': RD, 'anm': 'JEB24', 'date': '2023-11-03', 'probes': [1]},\\n]\\n\\n\\n# ============================================================\\n# HELPER FUNCTIONS\\n# ============================================================\\n\\ndef gausswin(N, alpha=2.5):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"MATLAB-equivalent gausswin(N, alpha).\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    if N == 1:\\n        return np.array([1.0])\\n    n = np.arange(N)\\n    n_norm = 2 * n / (N - 1) - 1\\n    return np.exp(-0.5 * (alpha * n_norm) ** 2)\\n\\n\\ndef causal_smooth(x, N=SMOOTH_N, bctype=BC_TYPE):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Causal Gaussian smoothing matching mySmooth.m.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    if N <= 1:\\n        return x.copy()\\n    kern = gausswin(N)\\n    kern[:N // 2] = 0   # causal: zero out first half\\n    kern /= kern.sum()\\n\\n    if bctype == 'reflect':\\n        x_padded = np.concatenate([x[:N], x])\\n        trim = N\\n    elif bctype == 'zeropad':\\n        x_padded = np.concatenate([np.zeros(N), x])\\n        trim = N\\n    else:\\n        x_padded = x.copy()\\n        trim = 0\\n\\n    out = np.convolve(x_padded, kern, mode='same')\\n    return out[trim:]\\n\\n\\ndef h5str(f, ref):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Read string from HDF5 object reference.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    data = f[ref][()].flatten()\\n    return ''.join(chr(int(c)) for c in data)\\n\\n\\ndef fill_nan_nearest(arr):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Fill NaN values with nearest non-NaN, matching MATLAB fillmissing('nearest').\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    nans = np.isnan(arr)\\n    if not np.any(nans):\\n        return arr\\n    if np.all(nans):\\n        arr[:] = 0\\n        return arr\\n    valid_idx = np.where(~nans)[0]\\n    f_interp = interp1d(valid_idx, arr[valid_idx], kind='nearest',\\n                        fill_value='extrapolate', bounds_error=False)\\n    arr[nans] = f_interp(np.where(nans)[0])\\n    return arr\\n\\n\\ndef compute_mode(arr):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Compute statistical mode.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    arr = arr[~np.isnan(arr)]\\n    if len(arr) == 0:\\n        return 0.0\\n    vals, counts = np.unique(arr, return_counts=True)\\n    return float(vals[np.argmax(counts)])\\n\\n\\ndef fill_positions_nearest(x, y, valid_mask):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Fill invalid positions with nearest valid values.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    x, y = x.copy(), y.copy()\\n    if not np.any(valid_mask) or np.all(valid_mask):\\n        return x, y\\n    valid_idx = np.where(valid_mask)[0]\\n    bad_idx = np.where(~valid_mask)[0]\\n    nearest = np.searchsorted(valid_idx, bad_idx).clip(0, len(valid_idx) - 1)\\n    # Check left neighbor too for true nearest\\n    left = np.clip(nearest - 1, 0, len(valid_idx) - 1)\\n    d_right = np.abs(bad_idx - valid_idx[nearest])\\n    d_left = np.abs(bad_idx - valid_idx[left])\\n    use_left = d_left < d_right\\n    final = np.where(use_left, left, nearest)\\n    x[bad_idx] = x[valid_idx[final]]\\n    y[bad_idx] = y[valid_idx[final]]\\n    return x, y\\n\\n\\ndef compute_speed(x, y, ft, confidence=None, conf_thresh=DLC_CONF,\\n                  fill_missing=True):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Compute instantaneous speed from (x, y) trajectory.\\n\\n    For all features, fills NaN/low-confidence positions with nearest valid\\n    position before computing velocity, matching the paper's processing for\\n    kinematic features. For tongue, positions are NaN when not visible; filling\\n    gives near-zero velocity during non-licking periods and meaningful velocity\\n    during licking.\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    x = x.copy().astype(np.float64)\\n    y = y.copy().astype(np.float64)\\n\\n    # Determine valid frames: not NaN and (optionally) high confidence\\n    valid = ~np.isnan(x) & ~np.isnan(y)\\n    if confidence is not None:\\n        valid = valid & (confidence >= conf_thresh)\\n\\n    if np.any(valid) and not np.all(valid):\\n        x, y = fill_positions_nearest(x, y, valid)\\n    elif not np.any(valid):\\n        return np.zeros(len(x))\\n\\n    # Remove remaining NaN (shouldn't happen after fill, but safety)\\n    x = np.nan_to_num(x, nan=0.0)\\n    y = np.nan_to_num(y, nan=0.0)\\n\\n    dt_vid = np.diff(ft)\\n    dt_vid[dt_vid <= 0] = 1.0 / 400.0\\n\\n    vx = np.diff(x) / dt_vid\\n    vy = np.diff(y) / dt_vid\\n    speed = np.sqrt(vx**2 + vy**2)\\n    speed = np.concatenate([[0.0], speed])\\n\\n    return speed\\n\\n\\n# ============================================================\\n# SESSION PROCESSING\\n# ============================================================\\n\\ndef _is_hdf5(path):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Check if a .mat file is HDF5 (MATLAB v7.3) format.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    try:\\n        with open(path, 'rb') as fp:\\n            header = fp.read(4)\\n        return header == b'\\\\x89HDF'\\n    except Exception:\\n        return False\\n\\n\\ndef _load_session_v5(data_path, sess):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Load session data from MATLAB v5 format into common dict.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    d = scipy.io.loadmat(data_path)\\n    obj = d['obj']\\n    bp = obj['bp'][0, 0]\\n\\n    n_trials = int(bp['Ntrials'][0, 0])\\n    hit = bp['hit'][0, 0].flatten()[:n_trials].astype(int)\\n    miss = bp['miss'][0, 0].flatten()[:n_trials].astype(int)\\n    early = bp['early'][0, 0].flatten()[:n_trials].astype(int)\\n    no_resp = bp['no'][0, 0].flatten()[:n_trials].astype(int)\\n    L = bp['L'][0, 0].flatten()[:n_trials].astype(int)\\n    R = bp['R'][0, 0].flatten()[:n_trials].astype(int)\\n    autowater = bp['autowater'][0, 0].flatten()[:n_trials].astype(int)\\n\\n    stim = bp['stim'][0, 0]\\n    stim_en_raw = stim['enable'][0, 0]\\n    if stim_en_raw.ndim >= 2:\\n        stim_en = stim_en_raw.flatten()[:n_trials].astype(int)\\n    else:\\n        stim_en = stim_en_raw.flatten()[:n_trials].astype(int)\\n\\n    ev = bp['ev'][0, 0]\\n    goCue = ev['goCue'][0, 0].flatten()[:n_trials].astype(float)\\n\\n    # video offset\\n    try:\\n        bitStart_vals = ev['bitStart'][0, 0].flatten()[:n_trials].astype(float)\\n        bitStart_mode = compute_mode(bitStart_vals)\\n        sglx = obj['sglx'][0, 0]\\n        bc = sglx['bitcode'][0, 0]\\n        bc_bs = bc['bitstart'][0, 0].flatten().astype(float)\\n        bc_bs_mode = compute_mode(bc_bs)\\n        fs = float(sglx['fs'][0, 0])\\n        vidshift = bc_bs_mode / fs - bitStart_mode\\n    except Exception as e:\\n        vidshift = 0.5\\n\\n    # cluster data\\n    clu_cell = obj['clu'][0, 0]  # (1, nProbes) object array\\n    spike_data = []\\n    for prb in sess['probes']:\\n        pidx = prb - 1\\n        try:\\n            probe_arr = clu_cell[0, pidx]  # struct array (1, nClusters)\\n        except Exception:\\n            print(f\\\"  Probe {prb}: empty\\\")\\n            continue\\n        n_clu = probe_arr.shape[1]\\n        qualities = []\\n        for i in range(n_clu):\\n            q = str(probe_arr['quality'][0, i].item()).strip()\\n            qualities.append(q)\\n\\n        valid_clu = [i for i, q in enumerate(qualities)\\n                     if q.lower() not in EXCLUDED_QUALITIES and q != '']\\n        q_counts = {}\\n        for q in qualities:\\n            q_counts[q] = q_counts.get(q, 0) + 1\\n        print(f\\\"  Probe {prb}: {n_clu} total, {len(valid_clu)} valid  {q_counts}\\\")\\n\\n        for ci in valid_clu:\\n            spike_data.append({\\n                'trial': probe_arr['trial'][0, ci].flatten().astype(float),\\n                'trialtm': probe_arr['trialtm'][0, ci].flatten().astype(float),\\n            })\\n\\n    # DLC bottom cam\\n    traj_cell = obj['traj'][0, 0]  # (1, 2) for [side, bottom]\\n    bot_cam = None\\n    try:\\n        bot_arr = traj_cell[0, 1]  # struct array (1, nTrials)\\n        # feature names from first trial\\n        fn_raw = bot_arr[0, 0]['featNames']\\n        feat_names = []\\n        for i in range(fn_raw.shape[0]):\\n            try:\\n                feat_names.append(str(fn_raw[i, 0].item()))\\n            except Exception:\\n                feat_names.append(str(fn_raw[i].item()))\\n        if not feat_names:\\n            for i in range(fn_raw.shape[1]):\\n                feat_names.append(str(fn_raw[0, i].item()))\\n\\n        bot_cam = {'feat_names': feat_names, 'n_cam_trials': bot_arr.shape[1]}\\n\\n        def get_bot_trial(ti):\\n            t = bot_arr[0, ti]\\n            ts = t['ts'].astype(float)  # (nframes, 3, nfeat)\\n            ft = t['frameTimes'].flatten().astype(float)\\n            return ts, ft\\n\\n        bot_cam['get_trial'] = get_bot_trial\\n    except Exception as e:\\n        print(f\\\"  WARNING: DLC bottom cam: {e}\\\")\\n\\n    # side cam frameTimes\\n    side_ft = {}\\n    try:\\n        side_arr = traj_cell[0, 0]\\n        for ti in range(min(n_trials, side_arr.shape[1])):\\n            try:\\n                side_ft[ti] = side_arr[0, ti]['frameTimes'].flatten().astype(float)\\n            except Exception:\\n                pass\\n    except Exception as e:\\n        print(f\\\"  WARNING: side cam frameTimes: {e}\\\")\\n\\n    return {\\n        'n_trials': n_trials, 'hit': hit, 'miss': miss, 'early': early,\\n        'no_resp': no_resp, 'L': L, 'R': R, 'autowater': autowater,\\n        'stim_en': stim_en, 'goCue': goCue, 'vidshift': vidshift,\\n        'spike_data': spike_data, 'bot_cam': bot_cam, 'side_ft': side_ft,\\n    }\\n\\n\\ndef _load_session_h5(data_path, sess):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Load session data from HDF5 (v7.3) format into common dict.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    spike_data = []\\n    bot_cam = None\\n    side_ft = {}\\n\\n    with h5py.File(data_path, 'r') as f:\\n        obj = f['obj']\\n        bp = obj['bp']\\n\\n        n_trials = int(bp['Ntrials'][0, 0])\\n        hit   = bp['hit'][0, :n_trials].astype(int)\\n        miss  = bp['miss'][0, :n_trials].astype(int)\\n        early = bp['early'][0, :n_trials].astype(int)\\n        no_resp = bp['no'][0, :n_trials].astype(int)\\n        L     = bp['L'][0, :n_trials].astype(int)\\n        R     = bp['R'][0, :n_trials].astype(int)\\n        autowater = bp['autowater'][0, :n_trials].astype(int)\\n        stim_en   = bp['stim']['enable'][0, :n_trials].astype(int)\\n        goCue     = bp['ev']['goCue'][0, :n_trials].copy()\\n\\n        # video offset\\n        try:\\n            bitStart_mode = compute_mode(bp['ev']['bitStart'][0, :n_trials])\\n            bc_bs = obj['sglx']['bitcode']['bitstart'][0, :]\\n            bc_bs_mode = compute_mode(bc_bs)\\n            fs = float(obj['sglx']['fs'][0, 0])\\n            vidshift = bc_bs_mode / fs - bitStart_mode\\n        except Exception as e:\\n            vidshift = 0.5\\n\\n        # cluster data\\n        clu_group = obj['clu']\\n        for prb in sess['probes']:\\n            pidx = prb - 1\\n            try:\\n                prb_ref = clu_group[pidx, 0]\\n                prb_g = f[prb_ref]\\n            except Exception:\\n                print(f\\\"  Probe {prb}: empty\\\")\\n                continue\\n\\n            quality_ds = prb_g['quality']\\n            n_clu = quality_ds.shape[0]\\n            qualities = []\\n            for i in range(n_clu):\\n                try:\\n                    q = h5str(f, quality_ds[i, 0]).strip()\\n                except Exception:\\n                    q = ''\\n                qualities.append(q)\\n\\n            valid_clu = [i for i, q in enumerate(qualities)\\n                         if q.lower() not in EXCLUDED_QUALITIES and q != '']\\n            q_counts = {}\\n            for q in qualities:\\n                q_counts[q] = q_counts.get(q, 0) + 1\\n            print(f\\\"  Probe {prb}: {n_clu} total, {len(valid_clu)} valid  {q_counts}\\\")\\n\\n            for ci in valid_clu:\\n                spike_data.append({\\n                    'trial':   f[prb_g['trial'][ci, 0]][()].flatten(),\\n                    'trialtm': f[prb_g['trialtm'][ci, 0]][()].flatten(),\\n                })\\n\\n        # DLC bottom cam - read all trial data into memory\\n        traj = obj['traj']\\n        bot_trials_data = {}\\n        try:\\n            vbot_ref = traj[1, 0]\\n            vbot = f[vbot_ref]\\n            fn_ref = vbot['featNames'][0, 0]\\n            fn_arr = f[fn_ref][:]\\n            feat_names = [h5str(f, fn_arr[0, i]) for i in range(fn_arr.shape[1])]\\n\\n            for ti in range(n_trials):\\n                try:\\n                    ts = f[vbot['ts'][ti, 0]][()]\\n                    ft = f[vbot['frameTimes'][ti, 0]][()].flatten()\\n                    bot_trials_data[ti] = (ts, ft)\\n                except Exception:\\n                    pass\\n\\n            bot_cam = {'feat_names': feat_names, 'trials_data': bot_trials_data}\\n        except Exception as e:\\n            print(f\\\"  WARNING: DLC bottom cam: {e}\\\")\\n\\n        # side cam frameTimes\\n        try:\\n            vside_ref = traj[0, 0]\\n            vside = f[vside_ref]\\n            for ti in range(n_trials):\\n                try:\\n                    side_ft[ti] = f[vside['frameTimes'][ti, 0]][()].flatten()\\n                except Exception:\\n                    pass\\n        except Exception as e:\\n            print(f\\\"  WARNING: side cam frameTimes: {e}\\\")\\n\\n    return {\\n        'n_trials': n_trials, 'hit': hit, 'miss': miss, 'early': early,\\n        'no_resp': no_resp, 'L': L, 'R': R, 'autowater': autowater,\\n        'stim_en': stim_en, 'goCue': goCue, 'vidshift': vidshift,\\n        'spike_data': spike_data, 'bot_cam': bot_cam, 'side_ft': side_ft,\\n    }\\n\\n\\ndef process_session(sess, data_dir):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Process one recording session. Returns (result_dict, error_msg).\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n    anm, date = sess['anm'], sess['date']\\n    sname = f\\\"{anm}_{date}\\\"\\n    data_path = os.path.join(data_dir, sess['dir'],\\n                             f\\\"data_structure_{sname}.mat\\\")\\n    me_path = os.path.join(data_dir, sess['dir'],\\n                           f\\\"motionEnergy_{sname}.mat\\\")\\n\\n    if not os.path.exists(data_path):\\n        return None, f\\\"File not found: {data_path}\\\"\\n\\n    print(f\\\"\\\\n{'='*60}\\\")\\n    print(f\\\"Processing: {sname}  ({sess['dir']})\\\")\\n\\n    # ----------------------------------------------------------\\n    # Phase 1: Load data (auto-detect HDF5 vs v5)\\n    # ----------------------------------------------------------\\n    if _is_hdf5(data_path):\\n        sd = _load_session_h5(data_path, sess)\\n    else:\\n        sd = _load_session_v5(data_path, sess)\\n\\n    n_trials = sd['n_trials']\\n    hit, miss, early = sd['hit'], sd['miss'], sd['early']\\n    no_resp = sd['no_resp']\\n    L, R = sd['L'], sd['R']\\n    autowater, stim_en = sd['autowater'], sd['stim_en']\\n    goCue = sd['goCue']\\n    vidshift = sd['vidshift']\\n    spike_data = sd['spike_data']\\n    bot_cam = sd['bot_cam']\\n    side_ft = sd['side_ft']\\n\\n    print(f\\\"  Trials: {n_trials}  hit={hit.sum()} miss={miss.sum()} \\\"\\n          f\\\"early={early.sum()} no={no_resp.sum()} stim={stim_en.sum()} \\\"\\n          f\\\"WC={autowater.sum()}\\\")\\n\\n    # trial filter: (hit|miss) & ~stim & ~early\\n    use = ((hit == 1) | (miss == 1)) & (stim_en == 0) & (early == 0)\\n    trial_idx = np.where(use)[0]\\n\\n    if len(trial_idx) < MIN_TRIALS:\\n        return None, f\\\"Only {len(trial_idx)} usable trials\\\"\\n\\n    n_raw = len(spike_data)\\n    if n_raw < MIN_UNITS:\\n        return None, f\\\"Only {n_raw} neurons\\\"\\n\\n    # --- bin spikes, smooth (getSeq.m) ---\\n    fr = np.zeros((n_raw, T_BINS, n_trials), dtype=np.float32)\\n    for ni, spk in enumerate(spike_data):\\n        for ti in range(n_trials):\\n            mask = spk['trial'] == (ti + 1)\\n            if not np.any(mask):\\n                continue\\n            aligned = spk['trialtm'][mask] - goCue[ti]\\n            counts, _ = np.histogram(aligned, bins=EDGES)\\n            fr[ni, :, ti] = causal_smooth(counts.astype(np.float64) / DT)\\n\\n    # --- remove low FR (removeLowFRClusters.m) ---\\n    mean_fr = np.mean(fr, axis=(1, 2))\\n    keep = mean_fr > LOW_FR\\n    fr = fr[keep]\\n    n_neurons = int(keep.sum())\\n    print(f\\\"  Neurons: {n_raw} → {n_neurons}  (FR filter)\\\")\\n\\n    if n_neurons < MIN_UNITS:\\n        return None, f\\\"Only {n_neurons} neurons after FR filter\\\"\\n\\n    # --- DLC velocities (bottom cam) ---\\n    tongue_vel = np.zeros((T_BINS, n_trials), dtype=np.float32)\\n    paw_vel    = np.zeros((T_BINS, n_trials), dtype=np.float32)\\n\\n    if bot_cam is not None:\\n        try:\\n            feat_names = bot_cam['feat_names']\\n            tongue_fi = feat_names.index('top_tongue') if 'top_tongue' in feat_names else 0\\n            paw_fi = -1\\n            for pname in ['top_paw', 'bottom_paw']:\\n                if pname in feat_names:\\n                    paw_fi = feat_names.index(pname)\\n                    break\\n\\n            for ti in range(n_trials):\\n                try:\\n                    if 'get_trial' in bot_cam:\\n                        # v5 format\\n                        ts, ft = bot_cam['get_trial'](ti)\\n                        # ts shape: (nframes, 3, nfeat)\\n                        t_spd = compute_speed(\\n                            ts[:, 0, tongue_fi], ts[:, 1, tongue_fi], ft,\\n                            ts[:, 2, tongue_fi], DLC_CONF, fill_missing=True)\\n                    else:\\n                        # h5 format - ts shape: (nfeat, 3, nframes)\\n                        if ti not in bot_cam['trials_data']:\\n                            continue\\n                        ts, ft = bot_cam['trials_data'][ti]\\n                        t_spd = compute_speed(\\n                            ts[tongue_fi, 0], ts[tongue_fi, 1], ft,\\n                            ts[tongue_fi, 2], DLC_CONF, fill_missing=True)\\n\\n                    aln = ft - vidshift - goCue[ti]\\n                    interp_fn = interp1d(aln, t_spd, kind='linear',\\n                                         bounds_error=False, fill_value=np.nan)\\n                    tongue_vel[:, ti] = fill_nan_nearest(interp_fn(TIME_AXIS))\\n\\n                    # 243→    \"\"\"\n   244→    Get the 0th dimension from the data.\n   245→    Inputs:\n   246→        x: list of length nsessions, x[session] is a list of length ntrials[session], and x[session][trial] (d, T)\n   260→    Returns:\n   261→        min_x: numpy array of shape (dinput,), minimum input values\n   262→        max_x: numpy array of shape (dinput,), maximum input values\n   263→    \"\"\"\n [len(trial_indices[i]) for i in range(nsessions)]\n   599→        valid_trials_per_session = trial_indices\n   600→\n   601→    # Sample sessions with equal probability\n   602→    sessionplot = np.random.choice(nsessions, nsample, replace=nsample > nsessions)\n   603→\n   604→    trialplot = np.full((nsample,), -1, dtype=int)\n   605→    for session in range(nsessions):\n   606→        idx = session == sessionplot\n   607→        ncurr = np.count_nonzero(idx)\n   608→        if ncurr == 0:\n   609→            continue\n   610→        valid_trials = valid_trials_per_session[session]\n   611→        if len(valid_trials) == 0:\n   612→            continue\n   613→        # Sample from valid trials and map back to original trial indices\n   614→        sampled = np.random.choice(len(valid_trials), ncurr, replace=len(valid_trials) < ncurr)\n   615→        trialplot[idx] = valid_trials[sampled]\n   616→\n   617→    return sessionplot, trialplot\n   618→    \n   619→\n   620→def _prepare_session_data(neural: list, input: list, output: list, device, doutput: int = None):\n   621→    \"\"\"\n   622→    Helper function to prepare session data for training/validation.\n   623→\n   624→    Inputs:\n   625→        neural: list of length nsessions, neural[session] is a list of trials\n   626→        input: list of length nsessions, input[session] is a list of trials\n   627→        output: list of length nsessions, output[session] is a list of trials\n   628→        device: torch device to move data to\n   629→        doutput: number of output dimensions (if None, inferred from data)\n   630→\n   631→    Returns:\n   632→        session_data: list of dicts with 'neural', 'input', 'output', 'nneurons' tensors\n   633→        dinput: input dimension\n   634→        doutput: output dimension\n   635→    \"\"\"\n   636→    nsessions = len(neural)\n   637→\n   638→    # Determine dimensions\n   639→    # Find first non-empty 648→                    doutput = len(output[sess][0])\n   649→                else:\n   650→                    doutput = output[sess][0].shape[0]\n   651→            break\n   652→\n   653→    # Process input/output: replicate 1D along time axis\n   654→    input_processed = []\n   655→    output_processed = []\n   656→    for session in range(nsessions):\n   657→        input_session = []\n   658→        output_session = []\n   659→        for trial in range(len(neural[session])):\n   660→            T = neural[session][trial].shape[1]\n   661→            if input[session][trial].ndim == 1:\n   662→                input_trial = np.tile(input[session][trial][:, np.newaxis], (1, T))\n   663→            else:\n   664→                input_trial = input[session][trial]\n   665→            input_session.append(input_trial)\n   666→            if output[session][trial].ndim == 1:\n   667→                output_trial = np.tile(output[session][trial][:, np.newaxis], (1, T))\n   668→            else:\n   669→                output_trial = output[session][trial]\n   670→            output_session.append(output_trial)\n   671→        input_processed.append(input_session)\n   672→        output_processed.append(output_session)\n   673→\n   674→    # Create session data tensors\n   675→    session_data = []\n   676→    for session in range(nsessions):\n   677→        if len(neural[session]) == 0:\n   678→            session_data.append(None)\n   679→            continue\n   680→        neural_concat = np.concatenate([neural[session][trial].T.astype(np.float32) for axis=0).astype(np.float32)\n   682→        output_concat = np.concatenate([output_processed[session][trial].T for trial in range(len(output_processed[session]))], axis=0).astype(np.int64)\n   683→        session_data.append({\n   684→            'neural': torch.from_numpy(neural_concat),\n   685→            'input': torch.from_numpy(input_concat),\n   686→            'output': torch.from_numpy(output_concat),\n   687→            'nneurons': neural_concat.shape[1]\n   688→        })\n   689→\n   690→    return session_data, dinput, doutput\n   691→\n   692→\n   693→def train_decoder(neural: list, input: list, output: list, metadata: dict = {}, **kwargs):\n   694→    \"\"\"\n   695→    Trains a common decoder for all sessions to predict output from neural and input data.\n   696→    Jointly learns projection matrices for each session and separate shared decoders for each output dimension.\n   697→\n   698→    Inputs:\n   699→        neural: neural activity. neural is a list of length nsessions, neural[session] is a list\n   700→                of length ntrials[session], and neural[session][trial] is a numpy array of shape (nneurons[session], T[session][trial]),\n   701→                dtype = float32, giving the neural activity for that trial\n   702→        input: variables beyond neural activity the decoder should input, e.g. the stimulis, condition. input is a list of\n   703→                length nsessions, input[session] is a list of length ntrials[session], and input[session][trial] is a numpy array of\n   704→                shape (dinput, T[session][trial]), dtype = float32. with the input variable(s) for each timepoint.\n   705→                dinput is the number of inputs. For discrete inputs, use a one-hot encoding.\n   706→        output: variables we want to decode. output is a list of length nsessions, output[session] is a list of length ntrials[session],\n   707→                and output[session][trial] is a numpy array of shape (doutput, T[session][trial]) of dtype = int with\n   708→                categorical values for each timepoint. Each output[idx, t] is an integer from 0 to ncategories[idx]-1.\n   709→        metadata: optional dict with additional information about the experiment.\n   710→\n   711→        Algorithm hyperparameters can be passed as keyword arguments:\n   712→        npcs: number of projected dimensions to use (default: 10)\n   713→        num_epochs: number of training epochs (default: 200)\n   714→        lr: learning rate (default: 0.001)\n   715→        l1_weight: L1 regularization weight for projection matrices (default: 1e-4)\n   716→        svd_max_samples: maximum number of timepoints to use for SVD initialization (default: 50000).\n   717→                         If a session has more timepoints than this, a random subset will be used.\n   718→        svd_max_neurons: maximum number of neurons to use for SVD initialization (default: 2000).\n   719→                         If a session has more neurons than this, random Gaussian projection will be used.\n   720→                         The final weight is the product of the random projection and SVD matrices.\n   721→        ncategories: optional list of length doutput giving number of categories for each output dimension.\n   722→                     If not provided, will be inferred from data.\n   723→        balanced_loss: if True, use class-weighted cross-entropy loss to compensate for class imbalance.\n   724→                       Weights are inverse of class frequency. Default: False.\n   725→\n   726→    Returns:\n   727→        model: dict with trained decoder parameters. dict with the keys:\n   728→            'projection': list of length nsessions, projection[session] is a torch tensor of shape (npcs, nneurons[session])\n   729→            'decoder': list of length doutput, decoder[out_dim] is a torch linear layer for that output dimension\n   730→            'ncategories': list of length doutput, ncategories[out_dim] is the number of categories for that output\n   731→            'device': torch device used for training\n   732→\n   733→    \"\"\"\n   734→\n   735→    model = {\n   736→        'projection': [],\n   737→        'decoder': [],\n   738→        'ncategories': [],\n   739→        'device': None\n   740→    }\n   741→\n   742→    npcs = kwargs.get('npcs', 10)\n   743→    num_epochs = kwargs.get('num_epochs', 200)\n   744→    lr = kwargs.get('lr', 0.001)\n   745→    l1_weight = kwargs.get('l1_weight', 1e-4)\n   746→    device_str = kwargs.get('device', None)\n   747→    balanced_loss = kwargs.get('balanced_loss', False)\n   748→\n   749→    nsessions = len(neural)\n   750→    if device_str is not None:\n   751→        device = torch.device(device_str)\n   752→    else:\n   753→        device = torch.device('cuda' if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu')\n   754→\n   755→    model['device'] = device\n   756→    print('Using device:', device)\n   757→\n   758→    # Prepare training data using helper function\n   759→    session_data, dinput, doutput = _prepare_session_data(neural, input, output, device)\n   760→\n   761→    # Determine number of categories for each output dimension\n   762→    if 'ncategories' in kwargs:\n   763→        ncategories = kwargs['ncategories']\n   764→    else:\n   765→        ncategories = []\n   766→        for out_dim in range(doutput):\n   767→            max_cat = 0\n   768→            for session in range(nsessions):\n   769→                if session_data[session] is None:\n   770→                    continue\n   771→                max_cat = max(max_cat, int(session_data[session]['output'][:, out_dim].max().item()))\n   772→            ncategories.append(max_cat + 1)\n   773→\n   774→    model['ncategories'] = ncategories\n   775→\n   776→    # Compute class weights (always, for use in chance computation and optionally for balanced loss)\n   777→    class_weights = []\n   778→    class_fractions = []  # Store fractions for chance computation\n   779→    for out_dim in range(doutput):\n   780→        # Count occurrences of each class across all sessions\n   781→        class_counts = np.zeros(ncategories[out_dim])\n   782→        for session in range(nsessions):\n   783→            if session_data[session] is None:\n   784→                continue\n   785→            outputs = session_data[session]['output'][:, out_dim].cpu().numpy()\n   786→            for c in range(ncategories[out_dim]):\n   787→                class_counts[c] += np.sum(outputs == c)\n   788→        # Store class fractions for chance computation\n   789→        total = np.sum(class_counts)\n   790→        fractions = class_counts / total\n   791→        class_fractions.append(fractions)\n   792→        # Compute weights as inverse of frequency (with smoothing to avoid division by zero)\n   793→        weights = total / (ncategories[out_dim] * np.maximum(class_counts, 1))\n   794→        # Normalize weights to sum to 1 (so each output dimension is equally weighted)\n   795→        weights = weights / np.sum(weights)\n   796→        class_weights.append(torch.tensor(weights, dtype=torch.float32, device=device))\n   797→\n   798→    model['class_weights'] = class_weights\n   799→    model['class_fractions'] = class_fractions\n   800→\n   801→    if balanced_loss:\n   802→        print(f\"Using balanced loss with class weights:\")\n   803→        for out_dim in range(doutput):\n   804→            print(f\"  Output {out_dim}: {class_weights[out_dim].cpu().numpy()}\")\n   805→\n   806→    # Initialize projection matrices for each session\n   807→    svd_max_samples = kwargs.get('svd_max_samples', 50000)  # Max timepoints to use for SVD initialization\n   808→    svd_max_neurons = kwargs.get('svd_max_neurons', 2000)   # Max neurons to use for SVD initialization\n   809→    projection_layers = []\n   810→    for session in range(nsessions):\n   811→        nneurons = session_data[session]['nneurons']\n   812→        proj = nn.Linear(nneurons, npcs, bias=False).to(device)\n   813→\n   814→        # Initialize with SVD for stability (use V from SVD of neural data)\n   815→        # For neural data with shape (n_timepoints, n_neurons), SVD gives principal components in V\n   816→        # Use random subsets if data is too large\n   817→        n_timepoints = session_data[session]['neural'].shape[0]\n   818→\n   819→        # Sample timepoints if needed\n   820→        if n_timepoints > svd_max_samples:\n   821→            time_indices = torch.randperm(n_timepoints)[:svd_max_samples]\n   822→            neural_subset = session_data[session]['neural'][time_indices, :]\n   823→            print(f\"Session {session}: Using {svd_max_samples} of {n_timepoints} timepoints for SVD initialization\")\n   824→        else:\n   825→            neural_subset = session_data[session]['neural']\n   826→\n   827→        # Use random projection if too many neurons\n   828→        if nneurons > svd_max_neurons:\n   829→            # Create random Gaussian projection matrix: (n_neurons, svd_max_neurons)\n   830→            P = torch.randn(nneurons, svd_max_neurons)\n   831→            # Project neural data: (n_timepoints, n_neurons) @ (n_neurons, svd_max_neurons) = (n_timepoints, svd_max_neurons)\n   832→            neural_projected = neural_subset @ P\n   833→            print(f\"Session {session}: Using random projection to {svd_max_neurons} of {nneurons} neurons for SVD initialization\")\n   834→\n   835→            # SVD on projected data\n   836→            _, _, V = torch.svd(neural_projected, some=True)\n   837→            # V has shape (svd_max_neurons, min(n_timepoints_subset, svd_max_neurons))\n   838→\n   839→            # Compose: final weight = (P @ V[:, :npcs]).T = V[:, :npcs].T @ P.T\n   840→            n_components = min(npcs, V.shape[1])\n   841→            proj.weight.data[:n_components, :] = (V[:, :n_components].T @ P.T).to(device).clone()\n   842→        else:\n   843→            # Standard SVD without random projection\n   844→            _, _, V = torch.svd(neural_subset, some=True)\n   845→            # V has shape (n_neurons, min(n_timepoints_subset, n_neurons))\n   846→            n_components = min(npcs, V.shape[1])\n   847→            proj.weight.data[:n_components, :] = V[:, :n_components].T.to(device).clone()\n   848→\n   849→        # Initialize remaining components randomly if needed\n   850→        if n_components < npcs:\n   851→            nn.init.orthogonal_(proj.weight.data[n_components:, :])\n   852→\n   853→        projection_layers.append(proj)\n   854→\n   855→    # Initialize separate decoders for each output dimension\n   856→    decoders = []\n   857→    for out_dim in range(doutput):\n   858→        decoder = nn.Linear(npcs + dinput, ncategories[out_dim]).to(device)\n   859→        decoders.append(decoder)\n   860→\n   861→    # Collect all parameters\n   862→    all_params = []\n   863→    for proj in projection_layers:\n   864→        all_params.extend(proj.parameters())\n   865→    for decoder in decoders:\n   866→        all_params.extend(decoder.parameters())\n   867→\n   868→    optimizer = optim.Adam(all_params, lr=lr)\n   869→\n   870→    # Loss function with reduction='none' for manual weighting (matches torch_brain)\n   871→    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(reduction='none')\n   872→\n   873→    # Training loop\n   874→    # Data stays on CPU; each session is moved to GPU one at a time.\n   875→    # backward() is called per session to free the computation graph before\n   876→    # loading the next session. Gradients accumulate across sessions.\n   877→    for epoch in range(num_epochs):\n   878→        epoch_loss = 0.\n   879→        optimizer.zero_grad()\n   880→\n   881→        for session in range(nsessions):\n   882→            if session_data[session] is None:\n   883→                continue\n   884→            # Move this session's data to device\n   885→            neural_batch = session_data[session]['neural'].to(device)\n   886→            input_batch = session_data[session]['input'].to(device)\n   887→            output_batch = session_data[session]['output'].to(device)\n   888→\n   889→            # Forward pass - shared projection\n   890→            projected = projection_layers[session](neural_batch)\n   891→            combined = torch.cat([projected, input_batch], dim=1)\n   892→\n   893→            # Compute loss for each output dimension\n   894→            session_loss = torch.tensor(0., device=device)\n   895→            for out_dim in range(doutput):\n   896→                logits = decoders[out_dim](combined)\n   897→                target = output_batch[:, out_dim]\n   898→                loss_per_sample = criterion(logits, target)\n   899→\n   900→                if balanced_loss:\n   901→                    # Manual per-sample weighting (matches torch_brain exactly)\n   902→                    sample_weights = class_weights[out_dim][target]\n   903→                    session_loss += (sample_weights * loss_per_sample).sum() / sample_weights.sum()\n   904→                else:\n   905→                    session_loss += loss_per_sample.mean()\n   906→\n   907→            # Add L1 regularization on current session's projection matrix\n   908→            if l1_weight > 0:\n   909→                l1_loss = torch.sum(torch.abs(projection_layers[session].weight))\n   910→                session_loss += l1_weight * l1_loss\n   911→\n   912→            # Backward per session: frees computation graph, accumulates gradients\n   913→            session_loss.backward()\n   914→            epoch_loss += session_loss.item()\n   915→\n   916→        optimizer.step()\n   917→\n   918→        if ((epoch + 1) % 10 == 0) or (epoch < 10):\n   919→            # Loss is sum of per-output-dim means across sessions\n   920→            # Normalize by (nsessions * doutput) to get average per output per session\n   921→            train_loss_normalized = epoch_loss / (nsessions * doutput)\n   922→            print(f'Epoch [{epoch+1}/{num_epochs}], Loss: {train_loss_normalized:.6f}')\n   923→\n   924→    # Store trained parameters\n   925→    for session in range(nsessions):\n   926→        model['projection'].append(projection_layers[session].weight.data.clone())\n   927→    model['decoder'] = decoders\n   928→\n   929→    return model\n   930→\n   931→def predict(neural: list, input: list, model: dict, sessionid: list | None = None, metadata: dict = {}):\n   932→    \"\"\"\n   933→    Uses a trained decoder model to predict output from neural and input data.\n   934→\n   935→    Inputs:\n   936→        neural: neural activity. neural is a list of length nsessions, neural[session] is a list\n   937→                of length ntrials[session], and neural[session][trial] is a numpy array of shape (nneurons[session], T[session][trial]),\n   938→                dtype = float32, giving the neural activity for that trial\n   939→        input: variables beyond neural activity the decoder should input, e.g. the stimulis, condition. input is a list of\n   940→                length nsessions, input[session] is a list of length ntrials[session], and input[session][trial] is a numpy array of\n   941→                shape (dinput, T[session][trial]), dtype = float32. with the input variable(s) for each timepoint.\n   942→                dinput is the number of inputs. Inputs:\\n        data: dict with keys 'neural', 'input', 'output' as described in train_decoder.py\\n        nsample: number of trials to sample\\n        trial_indices: optional list of length          continue\\n        # Sample from valid trials and map back to original trial indices\\n        sampled = np.random.choice(len(valid_trials), ncurr, replace=len(valid_trials) < ncurr)\\n        trialplot[idx] = valid_trials[sampled]\\n\\n    return sessionplot, trialplot\\n    \\n\\ndef _prepare_session_data(neural: list, input: list, output: list, device, doutput: int = None):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    Helper function to prepare session data for training/validation.\\n\\n    Inputs:\\n        neural: list of length nsessions, neural[session] is a list of trials\\n        input: list of length nsessions, input[session] is a list of trials\\n        output: list of length nsessions, output[session] is a list of trials\\n        device: torch device to move data to\\n        doutput: number of output dimensions (if None, inferred from data)\\n\\n    Returns:\\n        session_data: list of dicts with 'neural', 'input', 'output', 'nneurons' tensors\\n        dinput: input dimension\\n        doutput: output dimension\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    nsessions = len(neural)\\n\\n    # Determine dimensions\\n    # Find first non-empty session/trial\\n    for sess in range(nsessions):\\n        if len(neural[sess]) > 0:\\n            if input[sess][0].ndim == 1:\\n                dinput = len(input[sess][0])\\n            else:\\n                dinput = input[sess][0].shape[0]\\n            if doutput is None:\\n                if output[sess][0].ndim == 1:\\n                    doutput = len(output[sess][0])\\n                else:\\n                    doutput = output[sess][0].shape[0]\\n            break\\n\\n    # Process input/output: replicate 1D along time axis\\n    input_processed = []\\n    output_processed = []\\n    for session in range(nsessions):\\n        input_session = []\\n        output_session = []\\n        for trial in range(len(neural[session])):\\n            T = neural[session][trial].shape[1]\\n            if input[session][trial].ndim == 1:\\n                input_trial = np.tile(input[session][trial][:, np.newaxis], (1, T))\\n            else:\\n                input_trial = input[session][trial]\\n            input_session.append(input_trial)\\n            if output[session][trial].ndim == 1:\\n                output_trial = np.tile(output[session][trial][:, np.newaxis], (1, T))\\n            else:\\n                output_trial = output[session][trial]\\n            output_session.append(output_trial)\\n        input_processed.append(input_session)\\n        output_processed.append(output_session)\\n\\n    # Create session data tensors\\n    session_data = []\\n    for session in range(nsessions):\\n        if len(neural[session]) == 0:\\n            session_data.append(None)\\n            continue\\n        neural_concat = np.concatenate([neural[session][trial].T.astype(np.float32) for trial in range(len(neural[session]))], axis=0)\\n        input_concat = np.concatenate([input_processed[session][trial].T for trial in range(len(input_processed[session]))], axis=0).astype(np.float32)\\n        output_concat = np.concatenate([output_processed[session][trial].T for trial in range(len(output_processed[session]))], axis=0).astype(np.int64)\\n        session_data.append({\\n            'neural': torch.from_numpy(neural_concat),\\n            'input': torch.from_numpy(input_concat),\\n            'output': torch.from_numpy(output_concat),\\n            'nneurons': neural_concat.shape[1]\\n        })\\n\\n    return session_data, dinput, doutput\\n\\n\\ndef train_decoder(neural: list, input: list, output: list, metadata: dict = {}, **kwargs):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    Trains a common decoder for all sessions to predict output from neural and input data.\\n    Jointly learns projection matrices for each session and separate shared decoders for each output dimension.\\n\\n    Inputs:\\n        neural: neural activity. neural is a list of length nsessions, neural[session] is a list\\n                of length ntrials[session], and neural[session][trial] is a numpy array of shape (nneurons[session], T[session][trial]),\\n                dtype = float32, giving the neural activity for that trial\\n        input: variables beyond neural activity the decoder should input, e.g. the stimulis, condition. input is a list of\\n                length nsessions, input[session] is a list of length ntrials[session], and input[session][trial] is a numpy array of\\n                shape (dinput, T[session][trial]), dtype = float32. with the input variable(s) for each timepoint.\\n                dinput is the number of inputs. For discrete inputs, use a one-hot encoding.\\n        output: variables we want to decode. output is a list of length nsessions, output[session] is a list of length ntrials[session],\\n                and output[session][trial] is a numpy array of shape (doutput, T[session][trial]) of dtype = int with\\n                categorical values for each timepoint. Each output[idx, t] is an integer from 0 to ncategories[idx]-1.\\n        metadata: optional dict with additional information about the experiment.\\n\\n        Algorithm hyperparameters can be passed as keyword arguments:\\n        npcs: number of projected dimensions to use (default: 10)\\n        num_epochs: number of training epochs (default: 200)\\n        lr: learning rate (default: 0.001)\\n        l1_weight: L1 regularization weight for projection matrices (default: 1e-4)\\n        svd_max_samples: maximum number of timepoints to use for SVD initialization (default: 50000).\\n                         If a session has more timepoints than this, a random subset will be used.\\n        svd_max_neurons: maximum number of neurons to use for SVD initialization (default: 2000).\\n                         If a session has more neurons than this, random Gaussian projection will be used.\\n                         The final weight is the product of the random projection and SVD matrices.\\n        ncategories: optional list of length doutput giving number of categories for each output dimension.\\n                     If not provided, will be inferred from data.\\n        balanced_loss: if True, use class-weighted cross-entropy loss to compensate for class imbalance.\\n                       Weights are inverse of class frequency. Default: False.\\n\\n    Returns:\\n        model: dict with trained decoder parameters. dict with the keys:\\n            'projection': list of length nsessions, projection[session] is a torch tensor of shape (npcs, nneurons[session])\\n            'decoder': list of length doutput, decoder[out_dim] is a torch linear layer for that output dimension\\n            'ncategories': list of length doutput, ncategories[out_dim] is the number of categories for that output\\n            'device': torch device used for training\\n\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n    model = {\\n        'projection': [],\\n        'decoder': [],\\n        'ncategories': [],\\n        'device': None\\n    }\\n\\n    npcs = kwargs.get('npcs', 10)\\n    num_epochs = kwargs.get('num_epochs', 200)\\n    lr = kwargs.get('lr', 0.001)\\n    l1_weight = kwargs.get('l1_weight', 1e-4)\\n    device_str = kwargs.get('device', None)\\n    balanced_loss = kwargs.get('balanced_loss', False)\\n\\n    nsessions = len(neural)\\n    if device_str is not None:\\n        device = torch.device(device_str)\\n    else:\\n        device = torch.device('cuda' if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu')\\n\\n    model['device'] = device\\n    print('Using device:', device)\\n\\n    # Prepare training data using helper function\\n    session_data, dinput, doutput = _prepare_session_data(neural, input, output, device)\\n\\n    # Determine number of categories for each output dimension\\n    if 'ncategories' in kwargs:\\n        ncategories = kwargs['ncategories']\\n    else:\\n        ncategories = []\\n        for out_dim in range(doutput):\\n            max_cat = 0\\n            for session in range(nsessions):\\n                if session_data[session] is None:\\n                    continue\\n                max_cat = max(max_cat, int(session_data[session]['output'][:, out_dim].max().item()))\\n            ncategories.append(max_cat + 1)\\n\\n    model['ncategories'] = ncategories\\n\\n    # Compute class weights (always, for use in chance computation and optionally for balanced loss)\\n    class_weights = []\\n    class_fractions = []  # Store fractions for chance computation\\n    for out_dim in range(doutput):\\n        # Count occurrences of each class across all sessions\\n        class_counts = np.zeros(ncategories[out_dim])\\n        for session in range(nsessions):\\n            if session_data[session] is None:\\n                continue\\n            outputs = session_data[session]['output'][:, out_dim].cpu().numpy()\\n            for c in range(ncategories[out_dim]):\\n                class_counts[c] += np.sum(outputs == c)\\n        # Store class fractions for chance computation\\n        total = np.sum(class_counts)\\n        fractions = class_counts / total\\n        class_fractions.append(fractions)\\n        # Compute weights as inverse of frequency (with smoothing to avoid division by zero)\\n        weights = total / (ncategories[out_dim] * np.maximum(class_counts, 1))\\n        # Normalize weights to sum to 1 (so each output dimension is equally weighted)\\n        weights = weights / np.sum(weights)\\n        class_weights.append(torch.tensor(weights, dtype=torch.float32, device=device))\\n\\n    model['class_weights'] = class_weights\\n    model['class_fractions'] = class_fractions\\n\\n    if balanced_loss:\\n        print(f\\\"Using balanced loss with class weights:\\\")\\n        for out_dim in range(doutput):\\n            print(f\\\"  Output {out_dim}: {class_weights[out_dim].cpu().numpy()}\\\")\\n\\n    # Initialize projection matrices for each session\\n    svd_max_samples = kwargs.get('svd_max_samples', 50000)  # Max timepoints to use for SVD initialization\\n    svd_max_neurons = kwargs.get('svd_max_neurons', 2000)   # Max neurons to use for SVD initialization\\n    projection_layers = []\\n    for session in range(nsessions):\\n        nneurons = session_data[session]['nneurons']\\n        proj = nn.Linear(nneurons, npcs, bias=False).to(device)\\n\\n        # Initialize with SVD for stability (use V from SVD of neural data)\\n        # For neural data with shape (n_timepoints, n_neurons), SVD gives principal components in V\\n        # Use random subsets if data is too large\\n        n_timepoints = session_data[session]['neural'].shape[0]\\n\\n        # Sample timepoints if needed\\n        if n_timepoints > svd_max_samples:\\n            time_indices = torch.randperm(n_timepoints)[:svd_max_samples]\\n            neural_subset = session_data[session]['neural'][time_indices, :]\\n            print(f\\\"Session {session}: Using {svd_max_samples} of {n_timepoints} timepoints for SVD initialization\\\")\\n        else:\\n            neural_subset = session_data[session]['neural']\\n\\n        # Use random projection if too many neurons\\n        if nneurons > svd_max_neurons:\\n            # Create random Gaussian projection matrix: (n_neurons, svd_max_neurons)\\n            P = torch.randn(nneurons, svd_max_neurons)\\n            # Project neural data: (n_timepoints, n_neurons) @ (n_neurons, svd_max_neurons) = (n_timepoints, svd_max_neurons)\\n            neural_projected = neural_subset @ P\\n            print(f\\\"Session {session}: Using random projection to {svd_max_neurons} of {nneurons} neurons for SVD initialization\\\")\\n\\n            # SVD on projected data\\n            _, _, V = torch.svd(neural_projected, some=True)\\n            # V has shape (svd_max_neurons, min(n_timepoints_subset, svd_max_neurons))\\n\\n            # Compose: final weight = (P @ V[:, :npcs]).T = V[:, :npcs].T @ P.T\\n            n_components = min(npcs, V.shape[1])\\n            proj.weight.data[:n_components, :] = (V[:, :n_components].T @ P.T).to(device).clone()\\n        else:\\n            # Standard SVD without random projection\\n            _, _, V = torch.svd(neural_subset, some=True)\\n            # V has shape (n_neurons, min(n_timepoints_subset, n_neurons))\\n            n_components = min(npcs, V.shape[1])\\n            proj.weight.data[:n_components, :] = V[:, :n_components].T.to(device).clone()\\n\\n        # Initialize remaining components randomly if needed\\n        if n_components < npcs:\\n            nn.init.orthogonal_(proj.weight.data[n_components:, :])\\n\\n        projection_layers.append(proj)\\n\\n    # Initialize separate decoders for each output dimension\\n    decoders = []\\n    for out_dim in range(doutput):\\n        decoder = nn.Linear(npcs + dinput, ncategories[out_dim]).to(device)\\n        decoders.append(decoder)\\n\\n    # Collect all parameters\\n    all_params = []\\n    for proj in projection_layers:\\n        all_params.extend(proj.parameters())\\n    for decoder in decoders:\\n        all_params.extend(decoder.parameters())\\n\\n    optimizer = optim.Adam(all_params, lr=lr)\\n\\n    # Loss function with reduction='none' for manual weighting (matches torch_brain)\\n    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(reduction='none')\\n\\n    # Training loop\\n    # Data stays on CPU; each session is moved to GPU one at a time.\\n    # backward() is called per session to free the computation graph before\\n    # loading the next session. Gradients accumulate across sessions.\\n    for epoch in range(num_epochs):\\n        epoch_loss = 0.\\n        optimizer.zero_grad()\\n\\n        for session in range(nsessions):\\n            if session_data[session] is None:\\n                continue\\n            # Move this session's data to device\\n            neural_batch = session_data[session]['neural'].to(device)\\n            input_batch = session_data[session]['input'].to(device)\\n            output_batch = session_data[session]['output'].to(device)\\n\\n            # Forward pass - shared projection\\n            projected = projection_layers[session](neural_batch)\\n            combined = torch.cat([projected, input_batch], dim=1)\\n\\n            # Compute loss for each output dimension\\n            session_loss = torch.tensor(0., device=device)\\n            for out_dim in range(doutput):\\n                logits = decoders[out_dim](combined)\\n                target = output_batch[:, out_dim]\\n                loss_per_sample = criterion(logits, target)\\n\\n                if balanced_loss:\\n                    # Manual per-sample weighting (matches torch_brain exactly)\\n                    sample_weights = class_weights[out_dim][target]\\n                    session_loss += (sample_weights * loss_per_sample).sum() / sample_weights.sum()\\n                else:\\n                    session_loss += loss_per_sample.mean()\\n\\n            # Add L1 regularization on current session's projection matrix\\n            if l1_weight > 0:\\n                l1_loss = torch.sum(torch.abs(projection_layers[session].weight))\\n                session_loss += l1_weight * l1_loss\\n\\n            # Backward per session: frees computation graph, accumulates gradients\\n            session_loss.backward()\\n            epoch_loss += session_loss.item()\\n\\n        optimizer.step()\\n\\n        if ((epoch + 1) % 10 == 0) or (epoch < 10):\\n            # Loss is sum of per-output-dim means across sessions\\n            # Normalize by (nsessions * doutput) to get average per output per session\\n            train_loss_normalized = epoch_loss / (nsessions * doutput)\\n            print(f'Epoch [{epoch+1}/{num_epochs}], Loss: {train_loss_normalized:.6f}')\\n\\n    # Store trained parameters\\n    for session in range(nsessions):\\n        model['projection'].append(projection_layers[session].weight.data.clone())\\n    model['decoder'] = decoders\\n\\n    return model\\n\\ndef predict(neural: list, input: list, model: dict, sessionid: list | None = None, metadata: dict = {}):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    Uses a trained decoder model to predict output from neural and input data.\\n\\n    Inputs:\\n        neural: neural activity. neural is a list of length nsessions, neural[session] is a list\\n                of length ntrials[session], and neural[session][trial] is a numpy array of shape (nneurons[session], T[session][trial]),\\n                dtype = float32, giving the neural activity for that trial\\n        input: variables beyond neural activity the decoder should input, e.g. the stimulis, condition. input is a list of\\n                length nsessions, input[session] is a list of length ntrials[session], and input[session][trial] is a numpy array of\\n                shape (dinput, T[session][trial]), dtype = float32. with the input variable(s) for each timepoint.\\n                dinput is the number of inputs. Replicate 1D inputs along time axis to match neural data (make copies to avoid modifying original)\\n    input_processed = []\\n    for session in range(nsessions):\\n        input_session = []\\n        for trial in range(len(neural[session])):\\n            T = neural[session][trial].shape[1]  # time dimension\\n\\n            # Handle 1D input - replicate along time\\n            if input[session][trial].ndim == 1:\\n                input_trial = np.tile(input[session][trial][:, np.newaxis], (1, T))\\n            else:\\n                input_trial = input[session][trial]\\n            input_session.append(input_trial)\\n        input_processed.append(input_session)\\n\\n    # Use processed data instead of original\\n    input = input_processed\\n\\n    confidences = []\\n    predictions = []\\n    pcs = []\\n\\n    with torch.no_grad():\\n        for sessionidx in range(nsessions):\\n            if sessionid is not None:\\n                session = sessionid[sessionidx]\\n            else:\\n                session = sessionidx\\n\\n            ntrials = len(neural[sessionidx])\\n            session_predictions = []\\n            session_confidences = []\\n            session_pcs = []\\n            projection = model['projection'][session]\\n\\n            for trial in range(ntrials):\\n                # Get trial data\\n                neural_trial = torch.from_numpy(neural[sessionidx][trial].T.astype(np.float32)).to(device)  # (T, nneurons)\\n                input_trial = torch.from_numpy(input[sessionidx][trial].T.astype(np.float32)).to(device)    # (T, dinput)\\n\\n                # Project neural data\\n                projected = torch.matmul(neural_trial, projection.T)  # (T, npcs)\\n\\n                # Decode each output dimension\\n                combined = torch.cat([projected, input_trial], dim=1)  # (T, npcs + dinput)\\n                pred = np.zeros((neural_trial.shape[0], doutput), dtype=np.int64)  # (T, doutput)\\n                conf = np.zeros((neural_trial.shape[0], doutput), dtype=np.float32)\\n\\n                for out_dim in range(doutput):\\n                    logits = decoders[out_dim](combined)  # (T, ncategories[out_dim])\\n                    pred[:, out_dim] = torch.argmax(logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()\\n                    prob = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)\\n                    conf[:, out_dim] = prob.max(dim=1).values.cpu().numpy()\\n\\n                # (npcs, T)\\n\\n            predictions.append(session_predictions)\\n            pcs.append(session_pcs)\\n            confidences.append(session_confidences)\\n\\n    return predictions, pcs, confidences\\n\\ndef f1scores_all_sessions(all_predictions: list, output: list):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    Concatenate all predictions and ground truth to compute F1 scores across all sessions and trials\\n    Inputs:\\n        all_predictions: list of length nsessions, all_predictions[session] is a list of length ntrials[session],\\n                and all_predictions[session][trial] is a numpy array of shape (doutput, T[session][trial]) of dtype = bool\\n                with the predicted output variable(s) for each timepoint.\\n        output: the ground truth output for each trial. output is a list of length nsessions, output[session] is a list of\\n                length ntrials[session], and output[session][trial] is a numpy array of shape (doutput, T[session][trial])\\n                OR (doutput,) (scalar per trial), dtype = float32. with the output variable(s) for each timepoint.\\n    Returns:\\n        f1scores: numpy array of shape (doutput,) with the F1 score for each output dimension\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    nsessions = len(all_predictions)\\n    all_pred_concat = []\\n    all_output_concat = []\\n    doutput = output[0][0].shape[0]\\n\\n    for session in range(nsessions):\\n        for trial in range(len(all_predictions[session])):\\n            # Predictions are always (doutput, T)\\n            pred_trial = all_predictions[session][trial].T  # (T, doutput)\\n            all_pred_concat.append(pred_trial)\\n\\n            # Output can be (doutput,) or (doutput, T)\\n            output_trial = output[session][trial]\\n            if output_trial.ndim == 1:\\n                # Scalar per trial: (doutput,) -> expand to (T, doutput) where all T are the same\\n                T = pred_trial.shape[0]\\n                output_trial_expanded = np.tile(output_trial[:, np.newaxis], (1, T)).T  # (T, doutput)\\n                all_output_concat.append(output_trial_expanded)\\n            else:\\n                # Time-varying: (doutput, T) -> (T, doutput)\\n                all_output_concat.append(output_trial.T)\\n\\n    # Concatenate all timepoints from all trials and all sessions\\n    all_pred_concat = np.vstack(all_pred_concat)  # (total_timepoints, doutput)\\n    all_output_concat = np.vstack(all_output_concat)  # (total_timepoints, doutput)\\n\\n    # Compute F1 score for each output dimension (macro average for multiclass)\\n    f1scores = np.zeros(doutput)\\n    for out_dim in range(doutput):\\n        f1scores[out_dim] = f1_score(all_output_concat[:, out_dim], all_pred_concat[:, out_dim], average='macro')\\n\\n    return f1scores\\n\\ndef accuracy_all_sessions(all_predictions: list, output: list, balanced: bool = False):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    Concatenate all predictions and ground truth to compute accuracy across all sessions and trials.\\n    For categorical outputs.\\n\\n    Inputs:\\n        all_predictions: list of length nsessions, all_predictions[session] is a list of length ntrials[session],\\n                and all_predictions[session][trial] is a numpy array of shape (doutput, T[session][trial]) of dtype = int\\n                with the predicted categorical output variable(s) for each timepoint.\\n        output: the ground truth output for each trial. output is a list of length nsessions, output[session] is a list of\\n                length ntrials[session], and output[session][trial] is a numpy array of shape (doutput, T[session][trial])\\n                OR (doutput,) (scalar per trial), dtype = int with the categorical output variable(s) for each timepoint.\\n        balanced: if True, compute balanced accuracy (average recall per class) to compensate for class imbalance.\\n                  Default: False (standard accuracy).\\n    Returns:\\n        accuracies: numpy array of shape (doutput,) with the accuracy for each output dimension\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    from sklearn.metrics import balanced_accuracy_score\\n\\n    nsessions = len(all_predictions)\\n    all_pred_concat = []\\n    all_output_concat = []\\n    doutput = output[0][0].shape[0]\\n\\n    for session in range(nsessions):\\n        for trial in range(len(all_predictions[session])):\\n            # Predictions are always (doutput, T)\\n            pred_trial = all_predictions[session][trial].T  # (T, doutput)\\n            all_pred_concat.append(pred_trial)\\n\\n            # Output can be (doutput,) or (doutput, T)\\n            output_trial = output[session][trial]\\n            if output_trial.ndim == 1:\\n                # Scalar per trial: (doutput,) -> expand to (T, doutput) where all T are the same\\n                T = pred_trial.shape[0]\\n                output_trial_expanded = np.tile(output_trial[:, np.newaxis], (1, T)).T  # (T, doutput)\\n                all_output_concat.append(output_trial_expanded)\\n            else:\\n                # Time-varying: (doutput, T) -> (T, doutput)\\n                all_output_concat.append(output_trial.T)\\n\\n    # Concatenate all timepoints from all trials and all sessions\\n    all_pred_concat = np.vstack(all_pred_concat)  # (total_timepoints, doutput)\\n    all_output_concat = np.vstack(all_output_concat)  # (total_timepoints, doutput)\\n\\n    # Compute accuracy for each output dimension\\n    accuracies = np.zeros(doutput)\\n    for out_dim in range(doutput):\\n        if balanced:\\n            accuracies[out_dim] = balanced_accuracy_score(all_output_concat[:, out_dim], all_pred_concat[:, out_dim])\\n        else:\\n            accuracies[out_dim] = np.mean(all_pred_concat[:, out_dim] == all_output_concat[:, out_dim])\\n\\n    return accuracies\\n\\ndef cross_validate_decoder(neural: list, input: list, output: list, metadata: str | None = None,\\n                           nsets: int = 5,\\n                           eval_fn=None,\\n                           **kwargs):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    Cross-validates the decoder function. Performs nsets-fold cross-validation, training the decoder on nsets-1 sets and testing on\\n    the held-out set. Each cross-validation set contains 1/nsets of the trials from each session.\\n    Finds a random split of trials for each session into nsets sets, then, for each set, trains the decoder on the other nsets-1 sets and\\n    computes the predictions on the held out set.\\n    Then computes evaluation metric (F1 score or accuracy) for each output dimension\\n    Inputs:\\n        neural: neural activity. neural is a list of length nsessions, neural[session] is a list\\n                of length ntrials[session], and neural[session][trial] is a numpy array of shape (nneurons[session], T[session][trial]),\\n                dtype = float32, giving the neural activity for that trial\\n        input: variables beyond neural activity the decoder should input, e.g. the stimulis, condition. input is a list of\\n                length nsessions, input[session] is a list of length ntrials[session], and input[session][trial] is a numpy array of\\n                shape (dinput, T[session][trial]), dtype = float32. with the input variable(s) for each timepoint.\\n                dinput is the number of inputs. For discrete inputs, use a one-hot encoding.\\n        output: the ground truth output for each trial. output is a list of length nsessions, output[session] is a list of\\n                length ntrials[session], and output[session][trial] is a numpy array of shape (doutput, T[session][trial]),\\n                dtype = float32 or int. with the output variable(s) for each timepoint.\\n        metadata: optional dict with additional information about the experiment.\\n        train_decoder: function to train the decoder. Should have the signature\\n                model = train_decoder(neural_train, input_train, output_train, metadata, **kwargs)\\n                Default: train_decoder_linear\\n        predict: function to predict using the trained decoder. Should have the signature\\n                predictions = predict(neural_test, input_test, model, sessionid, metadata)\\n                Default: predict_linear\\n        nsets: number of cross-validation sets (default: 5)\\n        eval_fn: evaluation function to compute performance metric. Should have the signature\\n                scores = eval_fn(predictions, output)\\n                Default: accuracy_all_sessions (for binary outputs), can use accuracy_all_sessions for categorical\\n    kwargs are passed to train_decoder\\n    Returns:\\n        scores: numpy array of shape (doutput,) with the evaluation metric for each output dimension\\n        predictions: list of length nsessions, predictions[session] is a list of length ntrials[session],\\n                and predictions[session][trial] is a numpy array of shape (doutput, T[session][trial])\\n                with the predicted output variable(s) for each timepoint.\\n        pcs: list of length nsessions, pcs[session] is a list of length ntrials[session],\\n                and pcs[session][trial] is a numpy array of shape (npcs, T[session][trial]) with the projected neural data.\\n        confidences: list of length nsessions, confidences[session] is a list of length ntrials[session],\\n                and confidences[session][trial] is a numpy array of shape (doutput, T[session][trial]) with the confidence scores.\\n        trial_splits: list of length nsessions, trial_splits[session] is a list of length nsets,\\n                trial_splits[session][set] is a numpy array with the trial indices for that set for that session.\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n    if eval_fn is None:\\n        eval_fn = accuracy_all_sessions\\n\\n    nsessions = len(neural)\\n\\n    # Create random splits of trials for each session\\n    trial_splits = []\\n    for session in range(nsessions):\\n        ntrials = len(neural[session])\\n        trial_indices = np.random.permutation(ntrials)\\n\\n        # Split trial indices into nsets\\n        split_indices = np.array_split(trial_indices, nsets)\\n        trial_splits.append(split_indices)\\n\\n    # Initialize storage for all predictions (will be filled in during cross-validation)\\n    all_predictions = [[None for _ in range(len(neural[session]))] for session in range(nsessions)]\\n    all_pcs = [[None for _ in range(len(neural[session]))] for session in range(nsessions)]\\n    all_confidences = [[None for _ in range(len(neural[session]))] for session in range(nsessions)]\\n\\n    # Perform cross-validation\\n    for test_set in tqdm.trange(nsets):\\n        # Create training and test data for this fold\\n        train_neural = [[] for _ in range(nsessions)]\\n        train_input = [[] for _ in range(nsessions)]\\n        train_output = [[] for _ in range(nsessions)]\\n\\n        test_neural = [[] for _ in range(nsessions)]\\n        test_input = [[] for _ in range(nsessions)]\\n        test_output = [[] for _ in range(nsessions)]\\n\\n        test_trial_indices = [[] for _ in range(nsessions)]\\n\\n        for session in range(nsessions):\\n            for set_idx in range(nsets):\\n                trials_in_set = trial_splits[session][set_idx]\\n\\n                if set_idx == test_set:\\n                    # These trials go to test set\\n                    for trial_idx in trials_in_set:\\n                        test_neural[session].append(neural[session][trial_idx])\\n                        test_input[session].append(input[session][trial_idx])\\n                        test_output[session].append(output[session][trial_idx])\\n                        test_trial_indices[session].append(trial_idx)\\n                else:\\n                    # These trials go to training set\\n                    for trial_idx in trials_in_set:\\n                        train_neural[session].append(neural[session][trial_idx])\\n                        train_input[session].append(input[session][trial_idx])\\n                        train_output[session].append(output[session][trial_idx])\\n\\n        # _train_decoder_pca_logistic(neural: list, input: list, output: list, metadata: dict = {}, **kwargs):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    Trains a common decoder for all sessions to predict output from neural and input data.\\n    Concatenates data across trials for each session, then projects the neural data for each session onto its first npcs principal components.\\n    Then, concatenates data across all sessions and trains a common decoder across all sessions using logistic regression to predict output from the\\n    projected neural data and input data.\\n\\n    Inputs:\\n        neural: neural activity. neural is a list of length nsessions, neural[session] is a list\\n                of length ntrials[session], and neural[session][trial] is a numpy array of shape (nneurons[session], T[session][trial]),\\n                dtype = float32, giving the neural activity for that trial\\n        input: variables beyond neural activity the decoder should input, e.g. the stimulis, condition. input is a list of\\n                length nsessions, input[session] is a list of length ntrials[session], and input[session][trial] is a numpy array of\\n                shape (dinput, Use a one-hot encoding for multi-class outputs.\\n        metadata: optional dict with additional information about the experiment.\\n\\n        Algorithm hyperparameters can be passed as keyword arguments:\\n        npcs: number of principal components to use (default: 10)\\n\\n    Returns:\\n        model: dict with trained decoder parameters. dict with the keys:\\n            'pca': list of length nsessions, pca[session] is a PCA object fitted to the neural data of that session\\n            'logisticregression': list of length doutput, logisticregression[out_dim] is a sklearn LogisticRegression model\\n\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n    model = {\\n        'pca': [],\\n        'logisticregression': []\\n    }\\n\\n    npcs = kwargs.get('npcs', 10)\\n    nsessions = len(neural)\\n\\n    # MATLAB 1-indexed trials\\n                if not np.any(mask):\\n                    continue\\n                aligned = spk['trialtm'][mask] - goCue[ti]\\n                counts, _ = np.histogram(aligned, bins=EDGES)\\n                fr[ni, :, ti] = causal_smooth(counts.astype(np.float64) / DT)\\n\\n        #
